a.Grocery.Slug_attack.summary: These things are all over the place! Try using something from my store to get rid of them!
a.Grocery.Slug_attack.0: Hi there! We would like to buy some... OMG!!!
a.Grocery.Slug_attack.2: I don't speak gibberish but I think he needs our help!
a.University.Cleaniversity.summary: You saved me! Now let's save your professor who is currently at the university!
a.University.Cleaniversity.0: You saved me! How did you know that this thing is afraid of soda?
a.University.Cleaniversity.1: I didn't! But our professor always taught us to act first and think last!
a.University.Cleaniversity.2: Do you mean Mr. Brain? He is at the university now. Maybe he'll help you, although he didn't help me...
a.Hospital.Sloppy_genius.summary: I'm supposed to be very smart but I tend to forget some things. Help me unlock the lab!
a.Hospital.Sloppy_genius.0: Thanks for getting me out of the university!
a.Hospital.Sloppy_genius.1: No problem, professor! But what should we do next?
a.Hospital.Sloppy_genius.2: There's a laboratory in the hospital. We need to get there!
a.Hospital.No_mess,_no_stress.summary: Sorry, but I can't work on an empty stomach. Plus, everything here is a mess. Please, help me clean it up!
a.Hospital.No_mess,_no_stress.0: I wish we could start working on a solution right away but I'm so hungry...
a.Hospital.No_mess,_no_stress.1: We will get you something from the grocery store!
a.Hospital.No_mess,_no_stress.2: Thank you! Can you also help me tidy up this place?
a.Hospital.No_mess,_no_stress.3: Sure! We will be happy to do it when we're back!
a.Fruit_stand.Safety_first.summary: Help me get back to my stand without catching any of the brain slugs!
a.Fruit_stand.Safety_first.0: Thank you, Heroes! We have a visitor.
a.Fruit_stand.Safety_first.1: Hi there! My fruit stand is located nearby but I'm too scared of going there alone.
a.Fruit_stand.Safety_first.2: We'll walk you there. This hospital is full of safety gear!
a.Fruit_stand.Safety_first.3: And my store is full of fresh fruits which you can take whenever you want!
a.Fruit_stand.Helping_hand.summary: Help me to clean my store and enjoy unlimited access to everything it has to offer!
a.Fruit_stand.Helping_hand.0: Thank you, guys! Can you also help me to clean everything up?
a.Fruit_stand.Helping_hand.1: Of course! We'll get some gloves to put these creatures into backpacks so the professor can examine them.
a.Library.Plants_for_dummies.summary: My major is chemistry so I don't know much about plants but I need some references if we want to find the solution!
a.Library.Plants_for_dummies.0: Thank you for samples, Heroes! Can you also grab me a book about plants from the library?
a.Library.Plants_for_dummies.1: Sure! Do you have a specific book in mind?
a.Library.Plants_for_dummies.2: Not really. Ask the librarian for the best one in exchange for some strawberries.**
a.Library.Difficult_choice.summary: You've put me in a very difficult position. I need some extra time to think. Meanwhile, you can help me with the clean-up!
a.Library.Difficult_choice.0: Thank you for the treats but I can't choose just one book! I love them all!
a.Library.Difficult_choice.1: Please, give it another thought while we clean the building!
a.Library.Heavy_burden.summary: It's time to bring all the books to the professor so he can choose the one he needs!
a.Library.Heavy_burden.0: Alright! We have some books about plants! Let's carry them all to Mr. Brain using backpacks!
a.Botanical_garden.Outsourcing.summary: Even someone as bright as I cannot know everything. Get the books to my colleague and find out what missing ingredients are.
a.Botanical_garden.Outsourcing.0: Change of plans! Get even more books and bring them to my botanist friend.
a.Botanical_garden.Outsourcing.1: It might take a while but we'll try our best!
a.Botanical_garden.Hungry_Genius.summary: Yes, scientists are so busy that they don't have time to eat. So bring me something, please!
a.Botanical_garden.Hungry_Genius.0: Who are you and what do you want?
a.Botanical_garden.Hungry_Genius.1: We are friends of Mr. Brain and we need your help!
a.Botanical_garden.Hungry_Genius.2: I would love to help you but I can't think straight when I'm hungry...
a.Botanical_garden.Smart_and_smarter.summa: It's always better to have two great minds at your side when it comes to saving everyone! Let's pay Mr. Brain a visit!
a.Botanical_garden.Smart_and_smarter.0: Thank you, Mr. Green! Would you like to come with us and work on a formula together with Mr. Brain?
a.Botanical_garden.Smart_and_smarter.1: Sounds great! But first we should take care of the slugs!
a.Botanical_garden.The_final_preparation.s: All the ingredients are known. It's time to bring the equipment necessary to collect them!
a.Botanical_garden.The_final_preparation.0: Well done, Heroes! It's time to get some instruments before we can pick up the ingredients.
a.Botanical_garden.The_final_preparation.1: Just give us the list and we'll take care of the rest!
a.Meteostation.Magic_elixir.summary: With all the required instruments in place, you can finally get the ingredients!
a.Meteostation.Magic_elixir.0: It's time to cook this magic elixir! You know what we need and where to find it. Good luck, Heroes!
a.Meteostation.Magic_elixir.1: Thank you, Mr. Brain! We won't let you down!
a.Meteostation.You_shall_pass.summary: It's time to put the elixir into action. Clear the entrance and get to the station!
a.Meteostation.You_shall_pass.0: Alright! Let's hit the slime with the elixir.
a.Meteostation.You_shall_pass.1: After it's covered with our formula you can safely clean it up.
a.Meteostation.You_shall_pass.2: The slime will be completely harmless.
a.Meteostation.Save_the_technician.summary: We should mind our surroundings and make sure we don't miss anything or even anyone!
a.Meteostation.Save_the_technician.0: There is someone locked inside. Let's try opening the door!
a.Meteostation.Well_equipped.summary: I appreciate your help with letting me out but it's not over yet! We still need to fix the equipment!
a.Meteostation.Well_equipped.0: Thanks for saving me, guys! Now we should fix the equipment.
a.Meteostation.The_formula.summary: Let's save the district! You can be sure that your heroic feat will be never forgotten by the obliged citizens!
a.Meteostation.The_formula.0: The formula just needs a few last touches. Can you deliver the things from the list?
a.Meteostation.The_formula.1: Of course! Let's wrap it up!
a.Meteostation.The_formula.2: And do you mind bringing me something to drink? I've been here for a while and I'm so thirsty!
a.Meteostation.The_formula.3: You got it! Just keep up the good work and we will be right back!
a.Firestation.Unexpected_theft.summary: We've just lost our formula but we know who took it! Let's save the fire station before dealing with that.
a.Firestation.Unexpected_theft.0: Good job, everyone! Now when most of the slime is dealt with we can take care of the rest.
a.Firestation.Unexpected_theft.1: I don't mean to break your spirit but someone took our formula and all the ingredients while we were busy.
a.Firestation.Unexpected_theft.2: I think I know who it was! But we should save other buildings first!
a.Firestation.Warm_welcome.summary: It's nice to finally see Sugar Heroes come to our rescue! Help us and your good deed won't be forgotten!
a.Firestation.Warm_welcome.0: It's nice to see you, Heroes! Can you help us?
a.Firestation.Warm_welcome.1: It's what we do best. But we too will have to ask you for a favor.
a.Firestation.The_favor.summary: I remember you mentioning some favor? After all, you've done for the station you can ask for anything!
a.Firestation.The_favor.0: What was that favor that you wanted to ask?
a.Firestation.The_favor.1: Right! Do you have any friends at the police station?
a.Firestation.The_favor.2: Of course, we're all friends here! But their building is also affected.
a.Firestation.The_favor.3: Let's finish with you guys and then help your peers!
a.Firestation.Curse_of_knowledge.summary: I hope you know what you're doing, Heroes! Let's finish up here and move on!
a.Firestation.Curse_of_knowledge.0: By the way, why do you need the police?
a.Firestation.Curse_of_knowledge.1: They can help us catch the person responsible for that mess!
a.Firestation.Curse_of_knowledge.2: Wow, you know who did it?
a.Firestation.Almost_there.summary: Your example is very inspiring! Let's get to the police station and finish the investigation!
a.Firestation.Almost_there.0: We're almost done here! I thought it would be harder without the formula.
a.Firestation.Almost_there.1: I guess there is nothing you can't do!
a.Firestation.Almost_there.2: We can't stand the injustice that's for sure!
a.Police_Station.Top_floor.summary: It's great that you came to see me but first, you need to get to me!
a.Police_Station.Top_floor.1: Top floor. It won't be easy getting there...
a.Police_Station.Joined_forces.summary: I didn't think that Sugar Heroes will ever need my help but when we work together the evil has no chance!
a.Police_Station.Joined_forces.0: Firecracker! It's nice to see you! Did you bring friends with you?
a.Police_Station.Joined_forces.1: Yes, Magnum! And we need your help!
a.Police_Station.Joined_forces.2: My crew and I are at your service!
a.Police_Station.At_all_costs.summary: We need to do whatever it takes to stop the villain before it's too late!
a.Police_Station.At_all_costs.1: One of the locals caused all of it and we need to stop him before it's too late.
a.Police_Station.Greed_and_revenge.summary: Now when we know the motives of the villain it will be easier to catch him!
a.Police_Station.Greed_and_revenge.0: So, do you know why he did it?
a.Police_Station.Greed_and_revenge.1: It was one of Mr. Brain's ex-students. He was driven by greed and wanted revenge.
a.Police_Station.The_art_of_being_proactiv: The city bank has all the money. We can't let the villain steal it from the citizens!
So, where should we go after we're done here?
To the bank. We need to prevent the robbery before it's too late!
a.Bank.Unsafe_safe.summary: Although the safe stood the test of time it has never encountered the formula...
a.Bank.Unsafe_safe.0: Here we are, at the bank with the most advanced safe in place.
a.Bank.Unsafe_safe.1: Even this safe won't handle the formula designed to stop the slime.
a.Bank.The_heist.summary: The hole indicates the presence of the robber and it's crucial for the success of our operation!
a.Bank.The_heist.0: I can see a hole in the safe. The robber is already here.
a.Bank.The_heist.1: Let's hope he is not gone already.
a.Bank.Surprise.summary: Villains always think that they're the smartest ones in the room. It's time to prove them wrong!
a.Bank.Surprise.1: Heroes! How did you find me?
a.Bank.Surprise.2: You knew too much about the professor and his whereabouts for just a cashier!
a.Bank.Ugly_truth.summary: Nothing bad happens for no reason. It's easier to catch bad people when you understand their minds!
a.Bank.Ugly_truth.0: So, what's the story behind all that?
a.Bank.Ugly_truth.1: He used to conduct illegal experiments and was expelled by the professor.
a.Bank.Ugly_truth.2: And then I had to work as a cashier because nobody wants a university drop out!
a.Bank.The_Mastermind.summary: How does it feel to lose, Sugar Heroes? And you thought you had it all figured out...
a.Bank.The_Mastermind.0: So, he used his knowledge to contaminate the city?
a.Bank.The_Mastermind.1: What? I'm not that smart! I just wanted to screw Mr. Brain over and earn some money. I was told that the plan will work!
a.Bank.The_Mastermind.3: I guess it's the case you'll never solve, Heroes! Hahaha!
a.Prison.The_Rebuild.summary: The jail is in bad shape. But it's not a problem! Sugar Heroes will fix it in no time.
a.Prison.The_Rebuild.0: It's time to put this crazy person in jail. Where is the closest one located?
a.Prison.The_Rebuild.1: The closest one is right next to the Police Station. But it's in the terrible state.
a.Prison.The_Rebuild.2: It's safer to fix it than to travel to another location with the Cashier.
a.Prison.The_Rebuild.3: Okay then. Let's get to work!
a.Prison.Safety_Measures.summary: It's just safer to keep the Cashier here. Sugar Heroes know how to build things solid.
a.Prison.Safety_Measures.0: Why do you think it's unsafe to travel with the Cashier? He's no match for you!
a.Prison.Safety_Measures.1: It's still unclear who helped him to contaminate the city with the slime.
a.Prison.Safety_Measures.2: Do you think this person will attempt to free him?
a.Prison.Safety_Measures.3: We can't know for sure but it's better to take precautions.
a.Prison.Mysterious_Billionaire.summary: The funding has stopped but nobody can stop Sugar Heroes from helping others.
a.Prison.Mysterious_Billionaire.0: Anyway, why this prison is in such bad shape?
a.Prison.Mysterious_Billionaire.1: Its maintenance used to be sponsored by one of the citizens. As you can guess, the funding has stopped now.
a.Prison.Mysterious_Billionaire.2: Wow, it must have been some rich citizen. Did he go bankrupt?
a.Prison.Mysterious_Billionaire.3: Nobody knows what happened. He closed himself off from the outside world a couple of years ago. Not a soul has seen him since.
a.Prison.Finishing_Touches.summary: Sugar Heroes are almost done with the prison. From what I can tell it's going to be an absolute fortress!
a.Prison.Finishing_Touches.0: Is there anything else we need?

a.Prison.Finishing_Touches.2: Great! Let's collect the rest and get to work!
a.Prison.Last_Words.summary: Every criminal should think twice before harming our beautiful city full of nice people. Sugar Heroes are always watching!
a.Prison.Last_Words.0: Is there anything you’d like to say before being locked up?
a.Prison.Last_Words.1: Please, don’t do this, Heroes! I have a family. They need my help.
a.Prison.Last_Words.2: You should’ve thought about it before committing the crime.
a.Prison.Last_Words.3: Now you’ll have a lot of time to reevaluate your life!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.New_Mission.summary: We're always ready for new challenges! Every citizen can count on us!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.New_Mission.0: Look at this fortress! There is no way for its newest resident to escape.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.New_Mission.1: You've done an exceptional job, Sugar Heroes, and you deserve some rest but I have another mission for you.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.New_Mission.2: Don't worry, we were just getting started! What is it, detective?
a.Sugarcane_Farm.New_Mission.3: It's an incident that took place across town. Let's fill our tanks before going there.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Poor_Crop.summary: Something happened to my sugarcane crop. Hopefully, Heroes will help me. They always see things through!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Poor_Crop.0: Thank you so much for coming, Heroes! You are the only ones who can help me.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Poor_Crop.1: We are at your service! What seems to be the problem?
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Poor_Crop.2: My sugar cane crop has all wilted. I've been doing this for so many years and nothing like this ever happened!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Poor_Crop.3: Don’t worry! We might not be that agricultural savvy but our mentors are!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Scientific_Advice.summary: As always, I'm ready to help my students. Only this time the task may require the second opinion.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Scientific_Advice.0: Heroes! I’ve already started missing you. What brings you back to my lab?
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Scientific_Advice.1: We missed you too, professor. The city keeps us busy.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Scientific_Advice.2: Something strange is happening at the sugar cane plantation and we thought you might help us figure it out.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Scientific_Advice.3: It’ll be my pleasure! But first, let’s pay a visit to our favorite botanist!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Second_Opinion.summary: I love Sugar Heroes because they always bring me a good challenge. It keeps my brain working!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Second_Opinion.0: Hello, old friend! How have you been? Long time no see!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Second_Opinion.1: If I didn’t know any better I would’ve thought that you actually came to see me. What do you guys need?
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Second_Opinion.2: Sorry for ruining your day, Mr. Green, but we need your expertise on sugar cane.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Second_Opinion.3: Well, you came to the right place. Let’s see what you’ve got in store!
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Problem_Solving.summary: Well, it seems like the problem is going to be fixed for now. Although, some additional tests are in order.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Problem_Solving.0: Well, I have some theories about what could’ve caused it but I can’t say for sure before studying the samples.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Problem_Solving.1: Is there a way it can be fixed?
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Problem_Solving.2: Don’t you worry. I’ve already listed everything I need to resurrect the cane.
a.Sugarcane_Farm.Problem_Solving.3: We’ve got you, Mr. Green! Thanks for helping us out again!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.The_Celebration.summa: It's time to visit my old friend and celebrate another solved case at his factory!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.The_Celebration.0: It feels so nice helping each other out! I can’t wait to do it again!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.The_Celebration.1: Let’s celebrate the fact that the city is saved, the criminals are isolated and the sugar cane is back to live!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.The_Celebration.2: I know just a place to do that. My friend owns a candyfloss factory. He’ll be happy to treat us!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.The_Celebration.3: We shouldn’t show up empty-handed. It’s better to bring something with us.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Ruined_Plans.summary: That's not what I expected! But I'm not leaving until my friend gets all the help he might need.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Ruined_Plans.0: Oh my God! What happened here?
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Ruined_Plans.1: It’s been like this for a while now, Billie. You get used to things looking like this and to the factory not working.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Ruined_Plans.2: Why didn’t you contact me? I would’ve helped!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Ruined_Plans.3: You were busy saving the city from that pink menace. I didn’t want to impose.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Ruined_Plans.4: Well, we’re here now and we won’t leave until the factory is up and running again!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Spoiled_Goods.summary: It's great to have a friend like this! I'll make sure to shower him with candyfloss when everything is fine again.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Spoiled_Goods.0: Thank you so much, guys! I swear, when the site starts operating again you’ll have a life-long supply of candyfloss!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Spoiled_Goods.1: There is no need for that, Cotton! We would rather know what caused the malfunction?
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Spoiled_Goods.2: The strangest thing has happened. We were making the most delicious cotton candy in the city when one of the batches turned out bitter!
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Spoiled_Goods.3: Do you have some left? We would like to take it to the professor for analysis.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Spoiled_Goods.4: Help yourself to all of it. Our storage is packed with spoiled goods.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Big_Guns.summary: I didn't train Heroes to be scientists. I trained them to provide aid. There are times when they need it themselves.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Big_Guns.0: You did the right thing bringing it to me, Heroes but I need some extra equipment to study the sample.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Big_Guns.1: No problem, Mr. Brain! What do you have in mind?
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Big_Guns.2: Here is the list. But we need to act fast. It might be more serious than it seems.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Temporary_Fix.summary: Everything is fine now but it will go south again if we don't solve this problem at its core.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Temporary_Fix.0: My worst fears tuned out to be true. I can come up with a temporary solution for now but we need to be proactive.
a.Candyfloss_Factory.Temporary_Fix.2: Bring these ingredients to the plant and make a test batch. After making sure that it’s sweet, pay a visit to our friend at the prison.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.Return_of_the_Hero: It's time to visit our old friend. Let's find out what he knows!
Heroes! I’m so glad that you’re back. Please, release me. I’ll tell you anything you want to know!
You can start by telling us who helped you contaminate the city. It’s gotten out of hand now. Innocent citizens are suffering.
I’ve never seen this person. But he mentioned something about Water Treatment Plant.
It’s time to get some equipment and pay a visit to the water-work station. If what you said is true we’ll help with your parole.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.New_Problem.summar: Thank you for coming, Heroes! The sooner we fix the plant the fewer areas will be affected.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.New_Problem.0: Heroes! We were expecting you to come. As you can see, the water purification process was altered.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.New_Problem.2: We have no idea. And our brains aren’t big enough to think of a solution.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.New_Problem.3: Don’t worry! We know someone with a brain bigger than ours combined.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.Feast_of_Feats.sum: It seems like the city is once again in danger. And people say that being a professor is boring.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.Feast_of_Feats.0: So, what did you find out?
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.Feast_of_Feats.1: The cashier pointed us in the right direction as you predicted he will.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.Feast_of_Feats.3: The water treatment plant, Mr. Brain. It’s in trouble.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.Feast_of_Feats.4: What are we waiting for? Let’s grab some tools and go save the city! Again…
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.The_Founder.summar: It's great to see the person who created all of it. If he can't fix the problem nobody will!
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.The_Founder.0: Wow! Mr. Brain himself! It’s an honor to meet you, sir.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.The_Founder.1: The pleasure is all mine. I’ve engineered this water purification formula so I think fixing it wouldn’t be a problem.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.The_Founder.2: What do you need us to do, professor?
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.The_Founder.3: You’re second to none when it comes to tracking things. Items from this list a crucial to solving our problem.
a.Water_Treatment_Plant.Domestic_Detoxicat: Well, I've done everything I could. Now is the time for Sugar Heroes to shine!
Great job, Heroes! I’ve been able to enhance the formula. But too many areas got infected by intoxicated water. It’s your job to save them now.
You can count on us, professor. Thanks again for your help.
a.Flour_Mill.Help_Wanted.summary: Something happened at the water treatment plant. We need help, but we don't think that it was a mere malfunction...
a.Flour_Mill.Help_Wanted.0: This flour mill looks it could use some help. Is somebody there?
a.Flour_Mill.Help_Wanted.1: Yes, there is. Who is asking?
a.Flour_Mill.Help_Wanted.2: Sugar Heroes! We’re here to save your production which was affected by the water treatment plant malfunction.
a.Flour_Mill.Help_Wanted.3: I doubt that it was a malfunction but thank you!
a.Flour_Mill.Help_Wanted.4: Let’s start with cleaning the place.
a.Flour_Mill.Mysterious_Rumors_.summary: Mr. Brain is great. But with greatness come foes. At least that's what they say...
a.Flour_Mill.Mysterious_Rumors_.0: What did you mean when you said that it wasn’t a malfunction?
a.Flour_Mill.Mysterious_Rumors_.1: We’ve lived here our whole life and the water treatment plant brilliantly designed by Mr. Brain has never failed.
a.Flour_Mill.Mysterious_Rumors_.2: That’s true. The professor is pretty good at making things that last.
a.Flour_Mill.Mysterious_Rumors_.3: That’s why he has so many enemies. There are rumors that some powerful citizens want to get rid of him.
a.Flour_Mill.Mysterious_Rumors_.4: It’s an interesting theory. Tell us more about it when we are done cleaning the pipes.
a.Flour_Mill.Family_Business.summary: We appreciate your help. But it all seems like just the beginning of something much worse...
a.Flour_Mill.Family_Business.0: We’re so grateful, Heroes! This mill was incepted by our grandfather so it would’ve been a tragedy to lose it.
a.Flour_Mill.Family_Business.1: Don’t mention it. But do go on with your thoughts about Mr. Brain and his enemies.
a.Flour_Mill.Family_Business.2: My brother works as a guard at the new prison and he told me that the cashier knows more than he is willing to share.
a.Flour_Mill.Family_Business.3: We’ll make sure to pay him another visit after helping the affected businesses.
a.Flour_Mill.Lifetime_Supply.summary: Sugar Heroes helped me save our family's heritage. Providing them with a lifetime of flour is least I can do...
a.Flour_Mill.Lifetime_Supply.0: I’m sure that you get that a lot, Heroes, but I’m not sure if it’s going to be relevant in my case…
a.Flour_Mill.Lifetime_Supply.2: You’re always welcome to have as many of our products as you need! Although, why would you need the flour at all.
a.Flour_Mill.Lifetime_Supply.3: Thank you! But we’re just happy to help.
a.Flour_Mill.First_Priority.summary: A lot of local businesses have suffered. But what is a bakery without flour?
a.Flour_Mill.First_Priority.0: Well, we’re almost done here. Do you know anyone else who might need our help with fixing the issues caused by the intoxicated water?
a.Flour_Mill.First_Priority.1: I believe there are many cases like this but local bakery comes to mind first because it has also suffered from the lack of supply on our side.
a.Flour_Mill.First_Priority.2: Got it! Thank you and good luck passing on the mill to the next generation.
a.Bakehouse.Good_Neighbors.summary: My life journey has come to an end. There is nothing that could save me from this despair!
a.Bakehouse.Good_Neighbors.0: Hi there! Your neighbors here told us that you too were affected by the toxic water.
a.Bakehouse.Good_Neighbors.1: Affected? We were destroyed! Everything is gone. My bakery, my beautiful bakery is ancient history now!
a.Bakehouse.Good_Neighbors.2: Well, we’re sure that everything is not as bad as you think it is. Sugar Heroes are here to help you. Let’s get started!
a.Bakehouse.Mr._Macaron.summary: My bakery is ruined! I cannot produce my delicious pastries without flour and in such toxic conditions!
a.Bakehouse.Mr._Macaron.0: My poor, poor bakery! I didn’t even have a chance to say goodbye!
a.Bakehouse.Mr._Macaron.3: Everything is going to be alright, Mr. Macaron. We promise you!
a.Bakehouse.Positive_Thinking.summary: Everything is gone. I should come back to where I came from and accept my defeat!
a.Bakehouse.Positive_Thinking.0: My poor, poor bakery! It was so young and full of dreams!
a.Bakehouse.Positive_Thinking.1: It’s still young and has a lot of time to fulfill its dreams, Mr. Macaron. Trust us, it will be up and running in no time!
a.Bakehouse.Irresistible_Offer.summary: This is a miracle! My bakery is back! So is my life! Let's celebrate it by baking!
a.Bakehouse.Irresistible_Offer.0: My lovely, lovely bakery! It’s getting better! It’s a miracle!
a.Bakehouse.Irresistible_Offer.1: Well, it’s not actually a miracle but an elaborate effort of our cohesive unit. But you’re welcome!
a.Bakehouse.Irresistible_Offer.2: Thank you, Super Heroes! Let me cook something for you!
a.Bakehouse.Irresistible_Offer.3: We are Sugar Heroes, actually. And we are quite hungry indeed. Let us get you some ingredients!
a.Bakehouse.Restored_Beauty.summary: I'm in an unpayable debt to Sugar Heroes. From now on they are my favorite customers!
a.Bakehouse.Restored_Beauty.0: Thank you, Sugar Heroes! My bakery, my lovely bakery is almost as beautiful as before.
a.Bakehouse.Restored_Beauty.1: Thank you too for your delicious treats. With our energy levels restored we are ready to finish the job!
a.Sugar_Factory.Reaching_Out.summary: We have also suffered from whatever happened to the city. Sugar Heroes are the only ones who can help us.
a.Sugar_Factory.Reaching_Out.0: Hi, Sugar Heroes! Do you mind helping us? My partner, Cotton, told me that you saved his factory.
a.Sugar_Factory.Reaching_Out.1: It was nothing, really. We just provided the tools necessary to solve the problem.
a.Sugar_Factory.Reaching_Out.2: Well, that’s exactly what we need here!
a.Sugar_Factory.Interdependence.summary: These are tough times but we hope that Heroes will find a way to help all of us.
a.Sugar_Factory.Interdependence.0: How long have you known Cotton?
a.Sugar_Factory.Interdependence.1: I have been his sugar supplier for as long as his factory exists.
a.Sugar_Factory.Interdependence.2: We were able to solve his problem but we didn’t realize that the scale of it was so big.
a.Sugar_Factory.Interdependence.3: If you managed to help him I hope you’ll be able to fix my factory as well. We cannot exist without each other.
a.Sugar_Factory.Heroes’_Journey.summary: Maybe we weren’t heroes from day one. But our journey led us to this path and we couldn’t be happier about it!
a.Sugar_Factory.Heroes’_Journey.0: Have you always been Sugar Heroes?
a.Sugar_Factory.Heroes’_Journey.1: Not really. There was an accident which exposed us to a very strange force.
a.Sugar_Factory.Heroes’_Journey.2: And then Mr. Brain took us in. He trained and taught us day and night until we realized that helping others is our destiny.
a.Sugar_Factory.Heroes’_Journey.3: Well, he has every reason to be proud of you. So does the whole city!
a.Sugar_Factory.Inevitability.summary: It doesn’t matter who did this and why. Justice always finds its way and we are here to help it!
a.Sugar_Factory.Inevitability.0: Do you have any idea who caused all of this?
a.Sugar_Factory.Inevitability.1: Not yet. But whoever did this will inevitably face us at some point.
a.Sugar_Factory.Inevitability.2: Well, for every hero there is got to be a villain. And there are four of you.
a.Sugar_Factory.Inevitability.3: It doesn’t matter. We’ll be ready!
a.Sugar_Factory.The_Launch.summary: It’s time to gather everything that’s left and see if the factory works.
a.Sugar_Factory.The_Launch.0: It seems like everything is ready! Let’s restart the equipment and try to make something.
a.Sugar_Factory.The_Launch.1: Thank you so much, Heroes. Prepare to see the best sugar you’ve ever seen in your life!
a.Dairy_factory.Rumour_has_it_.summary: I invite you to help me with my factory, Heroes. Everyone is longing for a glass of fresh milk so let’s fix it!
a.Dairy_factory.Rumour_has_it_.0: There is a word going around that Sugar Heroes help everyone deal with the water toxification consequences.
a.Dairy_factory.Rumour_has_it_.1: Indeed we do. It will be our pleasure to get your factory up and running.
a.Dairy_factory.Rumour_has_it_.2: That’s fantastic news! Because life without fresh dairy is no life at all.
a.Dairy_factory.The_vocation.summary: I hope we can make it work sooner rather than later because I can’t wait to start making milk again!
a.Dairy_factory.The_vocation.0: We can’t even imagine how many productions had to stop because due to the lack of dairy supply.
a.Dairy_factory.The_vocation.1: You have no idea! It’s my vocation to be a milkman so seeing everyone drink tea without milk or eat bread without butter makes me sad beyond belief. You can relate to that.
a.Dairy_factory.The_vocation.2: Yes, we can’t imagine our lives without helping others. We would rather look for a missing cat than deal with such catastrophe but it is what it is.
a.Dairy_factory.Lord_McMuffin.summary: You should probably ask the professor about all this. Let’s focus on getting the factory to work.
a.Dairy_factory.Lord_McMuffin.0: We’ve been meaning to ask someone about this mysterious billionaire who used to support the city. Do you know anything about him?
a.Dairy_factory.Lord_McMuffin.1: Ah, yes. Lord McMuffin. I remember shaking his hand when he made a donation to our facility. You should ask Mr. Brain about him.
a.Dairy_factory.Lord_McMuffin.2: Do they know each other? How come he never told us about that?
a.Dairy_factory.Lord_McMuffin.3: Well, we all have our secrets. Sometimes it’s better to never reveal them.
a.Dairy_factory.True_colors.summary: You’re still young and have a lot to learn, Heroes. But the city is lucky to have you!
a.Dairy_factory.True_colors.0: It seems like you know the city pretty well. Do you have any ideas about who might’ve caused all this trouble?
a.Dairy_factory.True_colors.1: I have certain knowledge and I’m sure that it could’ve been anyone. We all have our reasons.
a.Dairy_factory.True_colors.3: Of course. You’ve just helped me install brand-new equipment and the demand for dairy is incredibly high. But did I do it? The answer is no.
a.Dairy_factory.Food_for_thought.summary: If you have any other questions in the future feel free to ask me. Thanks again for your help!
a.Dairy_factory.Food_for_thought.0: Well, it was our pleasure to help you, sir. We’re definitely going to leave your factory full of interesting thoughts.
a.Dairy_factory.Food_for_thought.1: Likewise, Heroes! I just hope that you come to the right conclusions. The fate of the city is in your hands.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Attention_to_details.s: Everything is even more serious than we thought. We need to stay sharp and watch out.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Attention_to_details.0: From now on, everyone is a suspect. We will help them with their problems but we’re also going to pay attention to the details.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Attention_to_details.1: I couldn’t agree more! Let’s grab some tools and start with the ice cream factory.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Little_Nudge.summary: Local workers seem a bit beaten down. It’s our job to restore their spirit.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Little_Nudge.0: Hello, how can I help you?
a.Ice_cream_factory.Little_Nudge.1: It’s the other way round. We help local businesses deal with the consequences of water plant accident.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Little_Nudge.2: I can’t do much here since the dairy factory is shut down.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Little_Nudge.3: As a matter of fact, we brought it back to life. And it looks like your place needs a little nudge too!
a.Ice_cream_factory.Quality_versus_Quantit: I'm new here so it’s nice to meet local Heroes at such an early stage although in such dramatic circumstances.
Weren’t you worried about going out of business? Why didn’t you approach us yourself?
I'm new in the city so I don't know anyone except the milkman. And he assured me that the help is coming.
It’s the perfect example of quality being more important than quantity. You only know one person who happens to know them all.
Thank you. And thank you for your help. Hopefully, you’ll become the next friends I’ll make.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Sweet_Dream.summary: My dream came true although I wasn’t happy for too long. Hopefully, everything will come back to normal quite soon.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Sweet_Dream.0: So, why did you decide to come here?
a.Ice_cream_factory.Sweet_Dream.1: I’ve always wanted to make ice cream so I was saving up some money to open my own factory but it was too expensive. I ended up buying an old one which happened to be in your city.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Sweet_Dream.2: We’ll try our best to get it running as soon as possible!
a.Ice_cream_factory.Friendly_city.summary: I’m so happy that I’m a part of this community now! It has always been my dream to serve good ice cream to good people.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Friendly_city.0: Well, I guess that is it. We just need to grab a few things to make sure that everything is working fine.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Friendly_city.1: Thank you so much, Heroes. I’ve never thought that I’ll be lucky enough to live in a city full of friendly people.
a.Ice_cream_factory.Friendly_city.2: Let’s hope that your delicious ice cream will make everyone even kinder!
a.Apiary.Bees_and_Buzz.summary: I apologize for my condition and I hope that the Heroes will help us save the Apiary.
a.Apiary.Bees_and_Buzz.0: Hi Heroes! Can you please help us with our problem?
a.Apiary.Bees_and_Buzz.1: Judging from your outfit it has something to do with the bees.
a.Apiary.Bees_and_Buzz.2: Can you, please, speak louder? I work at the local apiary and there is a constant buzzing in my head.
a.Apiary.Bees_and_Buzz.3: It’s okay, we’ve got you! We know nothing about the bees but there might be someone who does! Let’s ask him!
a.Apiary.Trick_and_Treat.summary: The bees are yellow. And black. That sums up our knowledge of them. That’s why Mr. Green’s participation is essential.
a.Apiary.Trick_and_Treat.0: Hello, Mr. Green! We’ve brought you something. We really hope that you would help us solve the apiary case.
a.Apiary.Trick_and_Treat.1: It’s nice to see you again, Heroes! Thank you for the treats. I’ll try my best. Especially if you provide me with the equipment.
a.Apiary.Exciting_task.summary: I love all nature-related things. That’s why helping out the local apiary is so exciting to me!
a.Apiary.Exciting_task.0: That is the friend you mentioned? It’s nice to meet you. Please, speak louder or I won’t hear you.
a.Apiary.Exciting_task.1: It’s nice to meet you too! Yes, Heroes warned me! Don’t you worry. Pretty soon you’ll hear the actual buzz and not the one in your head.
a.Apiary.Exciting_task.3: It’s nothing! I was just saying that your apiary is in good hands!
a.Apiary.Workaround.summary: Maybe we can ask Mr. Green about Lord McMuffin while he is in a good mood? It’s less scary than going straight to the professor.
a.Apiary.Workaround.0: Can we ask you an unrelated question, Mr. Green? It’s about the professor and his relationship with Lord McMuffin.
a.Apiary.Workaround.1: Hm. How do you know that name and why don’t you just ask Mr. Brain himself?
a.Apiary.Workaround.2: We’re kind of scared. He has never mentioned anything about it and maybe there is a reason for that.
a.Apiary.The_First_Hero.summary: The past doesn’t matter when we have such a bright present. We should appreciate it to ensure a promising future.
a.Apiary.The_First_Hero.0: Well, I’ll tell you this. Lord McMuffin was Mr. Brain’s first attempt to create a hero.
a.Apiary.The_First_Hero.1: Was it successful? What happened? Where is he now?
a.Apiary.The_First_Hero.2: It doesn’t matter, anymore. The city has you now. You’ve done such a great job saving it. Just keep up the good work!
a.Apiary.The_First_Hero.3: Thank you, Mr. Green. We’ll make sure to approach you if another nature-relater case comes our way.
a.Jam_Factory.Know-How.summary: It was nice to spend some time with Mr. Green and save the apiary but I already miss the direct involvement with the process.
a.Jam_Factory.Know-How.0: Come on Ed, I want to do something that will make me feel capable once again.
a.Jam_Factory.Know-How.1: I think there was a jam factory nearby. Sounds good enough?
a.Jam_Factory.Know-How.2: Are you kidding? It’s perfect! We know everything there is to know about jam. Let’s grab the essentials and go!
a.Jam_Factory.Sad_Story.summary: We can’t let this poor owner of the factory go on like this. It’s our destiny to help him get back on his feet!
a.Jam_Factory.Sad_Story.0: Hi there! What’s going on here? Let me guess, the incident at the water treatment plant?
a.Jam_Factory.Sad_Story.1: Uh, what incident? I went bankrupt. I live here because I don’t have anywhere else to go.
a.Jam_Factory.Sad_Story.2: Oh my God, we’re so sorry. Don’t worry, though! Things are about to change.
a.Jam_Factory.The_only_skill.summary: If you only possess one skill it’s your duty to perfect it and make it your mastery. We did it so everyone else can too.
a.Jam_Factory.The_only_skill.0: I still don’t understand how did it happen?
a.Jam_Factory.The_only_skill.1: I’m no accountant. I’m no salesman. I make jam. It’s not enough to run business.
a.Jam_Factory.The_only_skill.2: We’re good at only one thing too: helping those in need. Let’s wipe the dust off these machines and make some jam.
a.Jam_Factory.The_only_skill.3: We even know someone who might be interested in buying it.
a.Jam_Factory.Prospering_Business.summary: Of course, I’ll do anything for the Heroes. Whatever the favor is I will indulge it.
a.Jam_Factory.Prospering_Business.0: Hello, Heroes! My lovely, lovely bakery is prospering all thanks to you!
a.Jam_Factory.Prospering_Business.1: We’re glad to hear that. Actually, we came to ask you for a favor.
a.Jam_Factory.Prospering_Business.2: Anything for you, Heroes! Tell me what is that you want?
a.Jam_Factory.Prospering_Business.3: We need something that we can put some jam on.
a.Jam_Factory.Jam’s_destiny.summary: This tasty, tasty jam was destined to end up on my tasty, tasty croissants. I would love to share my prosperity with its creator.
a.Jam_Factory.Jam’s_destiny.0: So, how did you like this jam?
a.Jam_Factory.Jam’s_destiny.1: It is pure perfection! I’ve never tried anything like it before. It was designed for my croissants.
a.Jam_Factory.Jam’s_destiny.2: So, are you willing to buy some of it?
a.Jam_Factory.Jam’s_destiny.3: Some of it? I want an exclusive supply of this jam to my bakery!
a.Paper_Factory.Another_trouble.summary: It looks like even more industries suffered from the incident. Any help will be appreciated!
a.Paper_Factory.Another_trouble.0: Thank you so much, Heroes! Please, take some jam and treat the workers of the paper factory to it. They’ve been having a hard time too.
a.Paper_Factory.Another_trouble.1: It was our pleasure. We’ll soon check on you. As for now, the paper factory it is.
a.Paper_Factory.Setting_Priorities.summary: It’s important to stop the post office workers from using the spoiled envelopes but saving the paper factory won’t take long.
a.Paper_Factory.Setting_Priorities.0: Hi guys! We’ve come to help you. Can we, please, speak with the person in charge?
a.Paper_Factory.Setting_Priorities.1: Welcome to our factory, Heroes! My name is Chip and I’m glad that you’re here although it’s a bit late. We’ve send a batch of spoiled envelopes to the post office already.
a.Paper_Factory.Setting_Priorities.2: It’s certainly not ideal but first let’s focus on making your factory operational again. We will deal with the post office issue later.
a.Paper_Factory.Delayed_Effect_.summary: We’ll send drones to prevent the envelopes from reaching the post office but the equipment is the real problem here.
a.Paper_Factory.Delayed_Effect_.0: How come you didn’t check the envelopes before dispatching them?
a.Paper_Factory.Delayed_Effect_.1: We did. They were perfectly fine.
a.Paper_Factory.Delayed_Effect_.2: The envelopes aren’t a real problem. We can send drones to stop them. But your equipment is.
a.Paper_Factory.Delayed_Effect_.3: Yes, the intoxicated water damaged them irrevocably but it didn’t happen straight away.
a.Paper_Factory.Delayed_Effect_.4: Only because someone wanted this water to have a delayed effect.
a.Paper_Factory.Few_Tricks.summary: It feels nice to pay the Heroes back for saving me and the city. Let’s see what’s wrong with those machines.
a.Paper_Factory.Few_Tricks.0: Thank you so much for helping us with the drones.
a.Paper_Factory.Few_Tricks.1: Don’t mention it! Is there anything else I can do for you?
a.Paper_Factory.Few_Tricks.2: Actually, there is. Do you know anything about paper production?
a.Paper_Factory.Few_Tricks.3: Actually, I do! It was only my minor at college but I’ve learned a few tricks.
a.Paper_Factory.Sooner_or_later.summary: We understand that it’s just a temporary fix but we can’t face Mr. Brain right now. There are just too many unanswered questions.
a.Paper_Factory.Sooner_or_later.0: Well, I was able to figure out how to fix the machines but I have no idea how such an effect was caused. You should probably ask your professor about it.
a.Paper_Factory.Sooner_or_later.1: Yeah, we know. We just not ready for that yet. Thanks a lot for your help!
a.Paper_Factory.Sooner_or_later.2: No problem! You know where to find me if you’re ever in need of assistance again.
a.Post_office.Long-awaited_visit.summary: It’s nice to see Heroes finally reaching our post office. We hope that after their visit everything will be fine again.
a.Post_office.Long-awaited_visit.0: Hi everyone! We’re here to see if everything is alright.
a.Post_office.Long-awaited_visit.1: Hi, Heroes! Not really. Ever since that accident at the water plant, nothing has been the same.
a.Post_office.Long-awaited_visit.2: Don’t worry. We’re going to help you solve whatever problems you might have.
a.Post_office.Interesting_News.summary: We aren’t sure if Heroes are familiar with that but we are willing to share some information about their professor with them.
a.Post_office.Interesting_News.0: Before we continue we need to know if any of the spoiled envelopes were delivered to you from the Paper Factory?
a.Post_office.Interesting_News.1: No, they didn’t. At first, we were worried. But then the word came that this was a bad batch and they had to stop it halfway with your help.
a.Post_office.Interesting_News.2: That’s good news. Do you have any other news that could be of interest to us? We have too much on our plates to follow everything.
a.Post_office.Interesting_News.3: We might have something. It’s about Mr. Brain.
a.Post_office.The_Old_Lab.summary: You might want to go and check on the professor in his old laboratory after we’re done with this place.
a.Post_office.The_Old_Lab.0: So, what were you going to say about Mr. Brain?
a.Post_office.The_Old_Lab.1: It seems like he’s been spending a lot of time at the old laboratory nearby. It has been shut for years.
a.Post_office.The_Old_Lab.2: Do you know what he’s been doing there?
a.Post_office.The_Old_Lab.3: No, but we will give you directions so you could go there and ask him yourself.
a.Post_office.Final_Tests.summary: We’re almost there. Let’s run a few tests to make sure that everything is fine.
a.Post_office.Final_Tests.0: It seems like we’re almost done here. What are the next steps?
a.Post_office.Final_Tests.1: Let’s ask the guys from the paper factory for some paper.
a.Post_office.Final_Tests.2: We’re going to run some tests and wrap things up.
a.Post_office.Grateful_Citizens.summary: It’s been an honor to work alongside the Heroes. We really hope that our paths will cross again in the future.
a.Post_office.Grateful_Citizens.0: Thank you for your help, Heroes! The city lived without its mail for too long.
a.Post_office.Grateful_Citizens.1: No worries! Let us know if you need any assistance in the future.
a.Post_office.Grateful_Citizens.2: Sure! You too. If you ever need anything from us don’t hesitate to ask.
a.Laboratory.Long_time_no_see.summary: We’re finally ready to talk with Mr. Brain. It doesn’t necessarily mean that this is the only thing we’re going to do.
a.Laboratory.Long_time_no_see.0: Heroes! I haven’t seen you for a while. Is everything okay?
a.Laboratory.Long_time_no_see.1: We didn’t know that this laboratory is still operating.
a.Laboratory.Long_time_no_see.2: There are many things you don’t know. Isn’t it why you’re here?
a.Laboratory.Long_time_no_see.3: Yes. We have a few questions. But we would also like to help you clean everything here along the way.
a.Laboratory.Truth_Telling.summary: The Heroes are back with questions and I’m ready to give them the answers.
a.Laboratory.Truth_Telling.0: Thank you for helping me, Heroes! So, what would you like to know?
a.Laboratory.Truth_Telling.1: We are very curious about Lord McMuffin and what happened to him.
a.Laboratory.Truth_Telling.2: I knew that this day will come eventually…
a.Laboratory.Truth_Telling.4: The day when I’ll have to tell you the truth.
a.Laboratory.Actions_vs_Funds.summary: It’s strange talking with Sugar Heroes about Lord McMuffin. Although it’s essential for their understanding of things.
a.Laboratory.Actions_vs_Funds.0: He was my first hero-student. Very resourceful. He wanted to help others by sharing his money.
a.Laboratory.Actions_vs_Funds.1: Did you know him from university?
a.Laboratory.Actions_vs_Funds.2: No. I arranged a meeting and offered to teach him how to help others with actions rather than funds.
a.Laboratory.Full_stop.summary: I knew that training heroes was my vocation. That’s why it was so hard for me to reject my only student.
a.Laboratory.Full_stop.0: What happened after you started training him?
a.Laboratory.Full_stop.1: He was doing fine in the beginning. He showed great promise but still relied too much on his wealth.
a.Laboratory.Full_stop.2: What did you do about it?
a.Laboratory.Full_stop.3: I stopped our course and told him to come back when he would be ready.
a.Laboratory.Happy_Day.summary: The day Sugar Heroes were born is the happiest day of my life. I’m so glad that I was the one who's found you.
a.Laboratory.Happy_Day.1: Nothing. I went on with my life and gave up all the hope for creating a team of real heroes.
a.Laboratory.Happy_Day.2: How long did it go on?
a.Laboratory.Happy_Day.3: A couple of years. Then my radars registered some strange force. When I went to see what it was I’ve found you.
a.Laboratory.The_Meteorite.summary: I don’t know where from but it had fallen for a reason. Now our city has hope even in times like this.
a.Laboratory.The_Meteorite.0: I kept a piece of meteorite from the day we first met. It has special powers too. Although I still don’t know where did it come from.
a.Laboratory.The_Meteorite.1: Do you know what happened to Lord McMuffin?
a.Laboratory.The_Meteorite.2: By the time you became Sugar Heroes, he went bankrupt. He was trying too hard to prove me wrong.
a.Laboratory.The_Meteorite.4: I’ll take you there, Heroes. I promise. But first things first. Let’s help the citizens. Some of them are still suffering.
a.Beverage_Factory.Reinvigorated_Spirit.su: It feels nice when there are no secrets. We’re full of energy and are ready to help everyone!
a.Beverage_Factory.Reinvigorated_Spirit.0: It feels nice to have it lifted off our chests.
a.Beverage_Factory.Reinvigorated_Spirit.1: It is indeed. It makes you want to go out and help even more citizens!
a.Beverage_Factory.Reinvigorated_Spirit.2: I know exactly where are we going to go. But first, we need to grab all the vessels we can lay our hands on.
a.Beverage_Factory.Essential_Need.summary: Water is essential for making beverages so we had some trouble with that lately. Hopefully, our luck is about to change.
a.Beverage_Factory.Essential_Need.0: Your factory looks like it’s in a desperate need for renovation.
a.Beverage_Factory.Essential_Need.1: Hey Heroes! Fancy seeing you here. I guess we suffered the most from this Water Plant malfunction.
a.Beverage_Factory.Essential_Need.2: I guess you did. Don’t worry though. We're here and we’re not going away until you're back in business!
a.Beverage_Factory.Useful_connections.summ: Anyone in the city would agree that there is nothing we can’t do for the Heroes.
a.Beverage_Factory.Useful_connections.0: Welcome back, Heroes! How can we help you?
a.Beverage_Factory.Useful_connections.1: We need a favor. Considering that things are going fine we would like you to transfer as much pure water as possible to the  Beverage Factory.
a.Beverage_Factory.Useful_connections.2: Things are going great thanks to you! Consider it done.
a.Beverage_Factory.Useful_connections.3: Way to go, thank you! If you have any trouble you know where to find us.
a.Beverage_Factory.The_Best_Heroes.summary: It feels great to see hope again in people who once lost it. That’s what we’re here for.
a.Beverage_Factory.The_Best_Heroes.0: Thank for restoring the water supply. Can you also get us some ingredients?
a.Beverage_Factory.The_Best_Heroes.1: Of course. Just give us the list and we'll deliver them in no time.
a.Beverage_Factory.Farewell_gift.summary: These guys know what they’re doing! It’ll be our pleasure to help them out a little bit more before we go.
a.Beverage_Factory.Farewell_gift.0: So, how did you like the drinks that we made?
a.Beverage_Factory.Farewell_gift.1: Refreshing, very refreshing! With the quality like this, you’ll get back your customers in a blink of an eye.
a.Beverage_Factory.Farewell_gift.2: Thank you for your help and encouragement. We were also thinking about creating some new flavors.
a.Beverage_Factory.Farewell_gift.3: Say no more! We have time left so we’re going to treat you to some products you can experiment with when we’re gone.
a.Candy_Factory.At_your_service.summary: We are glad to have Sugar Heroes at our factory. We’re more than willing to provide them with the assistance necessary to succeed.
a.Candy_Factory.At_your_service.0: Welcome to our factory, Heroes! Is it fair to say that you came to restore its former glory?
a.Candy_Factory.At_your_service.1: That’s exactly why we are here! Now, let’s examine the damage and see what needs to be done in the first place.
a.Candy_Factory.At_your_service.2: Take your time. All our resources, or what’s left of them, are at your service.
a.Candy_Factory.True_Inspiration.summary: I’m not proud of where I come from. But I’m proud that I share this world with Sugar Heroes. They are a true inspiration!
a.Candy_Factory.True_Inspiration.0: You are in a pretty good mood for a person who went out of business.
a.Candy_Factory.True_Inspiration.1: It’s all due to my upbringing. You see, I come from a place of wealth and perfect manners. I chose my own way when I became of age. So I’m not here for the profits.
a.Candy_Factory.True_Inspiration.2: Wow, an aristocrat who went rogue. You don’t see it a lot these days.
a.Candy_Factory.True_Inspiration.3: Let me tell you that, Heroes. There’re many bad examples in this world but if I had to name a really good one I would pick you.
a.Candy_Factory.Common_good.summary: I find it more fulfilling to create something for everyone than worry about my own well-being. That’s what we have in common, Heroes.
a.Candy_Factory.Common_good.0: So, you left your family. Why did you decide to pursue a career in candy making?
a.Candy_Factory.Common_good.1: The process always fascinated me. While my ancestors found joy in exhausting natural resources with their sawmills and mines I was experimenting with tastes and creating joy for everyone.
a.Candy_Factory.Common_good.2: Do you still talk with your family?
a.Candy_Factory.Common_good.3: Yes. They try to involve me in the family business but I’m happy where I am.
a.Candy_Factory.Joy_Tasting.summary: We’ve been here for a while so we’re getting a bit hungry. It’s time to taste this joy the candy maker was bragging about.
a.Candy_Factory.Joy_Tasting.0: You’ve been saying a lot about how you bring joy to others. Is there a way to try some of it now?
a.Candy_Factory.Joy_Tasting.1: Well, thanks to you the factory is working again. It’s still in a dire need of redecorating but I can start cooking while you gracefully finish helping me out.
a.Candy_Factory.Joy_Tasting.2: Great! Let us get some ingredients first because something tells us that you’re going to need them.
a.Candy_Factory.Joy_Tasting.3: Please, do. Whatever you bring me I’ll make something truly delicious out of it.
a.Candy_Factory.Handyman.summary: The Heroes are in for a real treat. I’m really that good that I can make a candy out of anything.
a.Candy_Factory.Handyman.0: That was really good! You said that you can make a candy from anything?
a.Candy_Factory.Handyman.2: What if we bring you just a bunch of sugar and a piece of meteorite that has special powers?
a.Candy_Factory.Handyman.3: Then I’ll make you a candy with special powers.
a.Candy_Factory.Rainbow_Lollipop.summary: I hope that my latest creation helps Heroes on their journey. Outstanding characters deserve outstanding tools.
a.Candy_Factory.Rainbow_Lollipop.0: Wow, you weren't kidding. What is it?
a.Candy_Factory.Rainbow_Lollipop.3: You’ll have to find that out on your own. Consider it my thank you for all you’ve done for the city and me personally.
a.Candy_Factory.Rainbow_Lollipop.4: It’s been an honor meeting you. We just need to do one more thing and we’ll be on our way.
a.Observatory.Thirst_for_Knowledge.summary: Helping citizens is great but one can’t resist an opportunity like this when it comes knocking on the door!
a.Observatory.Thirst_for_Knowledge.0: I would love to go and help some more citizens but when I see an abandoned observatory I can’t help myself, Ed.
a.Observatory.Thirst_for_Knowledge.1: You have a point, Billie. Let’s grab the meteorite and try to find out where it’s from.
a.Observatory.Business_and_pleasure.summar: Even when our own origin is at stake we can’t help it but do something good along the way.
a.Observatory.Business_and_pleasure.0: It seems like no one is here so we’re on our own this time.
a.Observatory.Business_and_pleasure.1: This place looks so dirty. Shouldn’t we clean it first?
a.Observatory.Business_and_pleasure.2: Good idea! It’s more productive to work in an organized environment.
a.Observatory.From_space_with_love.summary: This astronaut looks like he might know something about meteorites. Let’s ask him!
a.Observatory.From_space_with_love.0: Who are you, guys, and what are you doing at my observatory?
a.Observatory.From_space_with_love.1: We’re so sorry. We didn’t mean to intrude. It was open and looked abandoned so we couldn’t resist our curiosity.
a.Observatory.From_space_with_love.2: Well, that understandable but I’ll have to ask you to leave.
a.Observatory.From_space_with_love.3: We will go but first, we would like to ask you a couple of questions about the meteorite.
a.Observatory.A_moment_of_sadness.summary: We were sorry to hear about his grandfather. Cleaning up with this place is the least we can do.
a.Observatory.A_moment_of_sadness.0: So, you are Sugar Heroes everyone’s talking about? I’m embarrassed. I spend so much time in space so it’s hard for me to keep track of things here.
a.Observatory.A_moment_of_sadness.1: No worries! We try to keep a low profile anyway. So, do you know anything about the meteorite?
a.Observatory.A_moment_of_sadness.2: Unfortunately, but I don’t. It was my grandfather who was curating that project. He passed away a couple of years ago.
a.Observatory.A_moment_of_sadness.3: We’re sorry to hear that. We’ll help you with cleaning this place up and will go on with our investigation.
a.Observatory.Important_Clue.summary: I’m sorry that I couldn’t help but I think it’s worth trying your luck at the local newspaper.
a.Observatory.Important_Clue.0: Wait, Heroes! I think there is something that might help you. Try paying a visit to the local newspaper’s building.
a.Observatory.Important_Clue.2: I believe they’ve published a story about this event when it happened.
a.Observatory.Important_Clue.3: Thank you for your help! Give us some time to polish your observatory and we will be out of your hair.
a.Local_Newspaper.Fair_exchange.summary: It’s always nice to help Heroes out but it’s definitely better when you get something in return.
a.Local_Newspaper.Fair_exchange.0: Hi everyone! Is this the best newspaper in the city?
a.Local_Newspaper.Fair_exchange.1: The best one in the world! Only we’ve stopped working since this water plant accident.
a.Local_Newspaper.Fair_exchange.2: We’re investigating the meteorite story. So let’s strike a deal. We help you bring everything back to normal and you help us dig up that piece from your archive.
a.Local_Newspaper.Fair_exchange.3: I would’ve helped you anyway but this sounds even better!
a.Local_Newspaper.Profitable_business.summ: Everyone loves stories and we have plenty to tell. I hope soon we’ll also have the means to tell them.
a.Local_Newspaper.Profitable_business.0: How was your business going before the collapse?
a.Local_Newspaper.Profitable_business.1: It was going great! So many stories to report. Even the accident helped us. We sold so many copies that the gained profit helps us stay afloat while we can’t print anything new.
a.Local_Newspaper.Profitable_business.3: About your heroic feat and some theories around who’s done it.
a.Local_Newspaper.Science_of_speculation.s: Everyone should be careful. The real villain is still out there looking for ways to harm the city.
a.Local_Newspaper.Science_of_speculation.0: What’s your personal favorite among those theories?
a.Local_Newspaper.Science_of_speculation.1: It’s obvious, isn’t it? The same person is behind that accident who was responsible for the pink slime invasion.
a.Local_Newspaper.Science_of_speculation.2: The cashier was captured before water intoxication was discovered.
a.Local_Newspaper.Science_of_speculation.3: We all know that he was just a pawn. The real villain is still out there.
a.Local_Newspaper.Trip_to_archive.summary: It won’t take long to get to the archive and find the story. It’s big and messy but I know it like the back of my hand.
a.Local_Newspaper.Trip_to_archive.0: We need a bit of time to make the press work. In the meantime, can you, please, go to the archive to fetch the story?
a.Local_Newspaper.Trip_to_archive.1: Sure, Heroes! I’ll be back in a jiffy.
a.Local_Newspaper.Trip_to_archive.2: Great! Hopefully, we’ll be done by then.
a.Local_Newspaper.Mysterious_disappearance: I don’t know who stole it and why but I certainly don’t like the way this new story is starting to smell.
I’m sorry, Heroes, but I'm afraid that I won’t be able to hold my end of the bargain.
Someone extracted the issue you were looking for from the archive.
Do you think it was the same person who was behind all of the attacks?
I’m not sure anymore. But one thing is for certain. I don’t like what’s happening one bit!
a.Sawmill.Family_matter.summary: Although we went our separate ways I won’t stand there and do nothing when someone from my family needs help.
a.Sawmill.Family_matter.0: I’m sorry to bother you, Heroes, but my brother, Jack, found out that you helped me with my factory and begged me to ask you to help him with his sawmill.
a.Sawmill.Family_matter.1: It’s kind of perfect because we need something to take our minds off of things. Just point us in the right direction.
a.Sawmill.Family_matter.2: Thank you. I know what I said about them but they’re still family.
a.Sawmill.Family_matter.3: We totally get it! Mr. Brain always taught us to never turn our backs on family.
a.Sawmill.Living_the_dream.summary: My dream came true! I’ve met Sugar Heroes and now I get to work alongside them at my sawmill. I’m living the dream!
a.Sawmill.Living_the_dream.0: I can’t believe my eyes! Sugar Heroes themselves at my sawmill! This doesn’t get any better!
a.Sawmill.Living_the_dream.1: It was a joy working with your brother so it’s our pleasure to meet you too.
a.Sawmill.Living_the_dream.2: Yeah, my brother is kind of an outcast in our family but we still love him. Let’s get to work!
a.Sawmill.Least_resistance_.summary: It takes a lot to be a real hero. How long can you go on without any help?
a.Sawmill.Least_resistance_.0: How come you and your brother are so different? He loves making candies and you cut down the trees and turn them into planks.
a.Sawmill.Least_resistance_.1: To each his own. Look at you, for example. You choose to do good deeds when you could easily be villains.
a.Sawmill.Least_resistance_.2: There was never a shortage of villains. If anything, the world needs even more heroes.
a.Sawmill.Least_resistance_.3: I couldn’t agree more but it requires much more resilience that’s why you’re alone against God knows how many threats.
a.Sawmill.Different_values.summary: I respect my brother and his choice and expect the same in return. As long as I’m here he doesn’t have to take over the family business.
a.Sawmill.Different_values.0: Do you think it’s possible for your brother to become a part of the family business at some point? Or is it more likely for you to start making candies?
a.Sawmill.Different_values.1: I believe neither of these scenarios is an option. I know him and he’ll trade happiness for money.
a.Sawmill.Different_values.3: Nothing is going to make me happier than being rich.
a.Sawmill.Useful_tip.summary: It was great having Sugar Heroes at my sawmill. I hope they find everything they look for at the mine.
a.Sawmill.Useful_tip.0: We’re almost finished. A couple more little things and we’ll continue our meteorite investigation.
a.Sawmill.Useful_tip.1: Are you interested in that thing that fell down from the sky a couple of years ago?
a.Sawmill.Useful_tip.2: Very much so. Do you know anything about it?
a.Sawmill.Useful_tip.3: No, but my cousin, Nick, does. He runs a mine not far from here. You should definitely pay him a visit.
a.Sawmill.Useful_tip.4: Oh, my God! How big is your family? Thank you. We’ll definitely go there after we’re done here!
a.Mine.Exceeded_expectations.summary: I’m so intrigued to see what Sugar Heroes can do here. Anyway, my daughter will be very happy to just know that they were here.
a.Mine.Exceeded_expectations.0: Hello! We're looking for Nick. His cousin told us that he might help us.
a.Mine.Exceeded_expectations.1: Greetings, Heroes! That would be me. Of course, I’ll help you but not before you help me first.
a.Mine.Exceeded_expectations.2: Sure, what can we do for you?
a.Mine.Exceeded_expectations.3: My daughter is dying for your signature. Can you, please, help her old man out?
a.Mine.Exceeded_expectations.4: We can do so much more than that!
a.Mine.Irresistible_offer.summary: When Sugar Heroes offer you their help you don’t say no to that. You simply ask them what can you do in return?
a.Mine.Irresistible_offer.0: Give us some time and space and we’ll make this mine look as good as new so your daughter could be proud of her father. What do you say?
a.Mine.Irresistible_offer.1: What do I say? Yes, a hundred times yes. A thousand times! Where do we begin?
a.Mine.Irresistible_offer.2: Let us worry about that. You can just go and deliver the good news to your girl.
a.Mine.Crystal_Rush.summary: This sounds interesting. We should definitely take some samples and bring them to the professor for further studying.
a.Mine.Crystal_Rush.0: So, what do you mine here?
a.Mine.Crystal_Rush.1: All sorts of things. This is probably the most diverse mine in the world. We’ve recently discovered something special covered deep in its subsoil.
a.Mine.Crystal_Rush.3: Some kind of crystal but not an ordinary one. It looks even more durable than the most solid diamond in the world.
a.Mine.Crystal_Rush.4: Do you mind if we take a sample to study it later?
a.Mine.Crystal_Rush.5: Are you kidding me? I’ll do anything for you after what you did for me and my daughter.
a.Mine.Main_question.summary: It was so exciting to help Nick with his mine that we almost forgot why we came here in the first place. Silly Heroes!
a.Mine.Main_question.0: By the way, we almost forgot to ask you. Do you know anything about the meteorite fall that took place a few years ago?
a.Mine.Main_question.1: Do I know anything about it? I was one of the first ones who took advantage of it.
a.Mine.Main_question.3: I convinced my parents to give me the money to open a mine at the very place where a meteorite has fallen.
a.Mine.Secret_ingredient.summary: We don’t want anyone to know about our connection to the meteorite without Mr. Brain’s approval. So let’s keep it a secret for a while.
a.Mine.Secret_ingredient.0: Why are you interested in this meteorite story?
a.Mine.Secret_ingredient.2: No particular reason. Just curiosity, I guess.
a.Mine.Secret_ingredient.3: Well, if you have more questions about it in the future don’t hesitate to ask them.
a.Mine.Secret_ingredient.4: Thank you, we appreciate it. We should probably start thinking where will we go after we’re done with your mine.
a.Power_Station.The_Fire.summary: I hoped that I’ll never have to ask Sugar Heroes for help again but now they are my only hope.
a.Power_Station.The_Fire.0: Heroes! Thank God you’re here! We need your help!
a.Power_Station.The_Fire.2: There was a fire at the Power Station. We don’t know what caused it but we won’t be able to deal with its consequences without you.
a.Power_Station.The_Fire.3: Sure. Let's grab all the equipment we might need and get going!
a.Power_Station.Honest_opinion.summary: Just between us, I’m pretty sure that it was arson and Sugar Heroes are the only ones who can solve this!
a.Power_Station.Honest_opinion.0: What do you think caused the fire?
a.Power_Station.Honest_opinion.1: Do you want an official mass media version or my honest opinion?
a.Power_Station.Honest_opinion.2: We always want your honest opinion, Firecracker.
a.Power_Station.Honest_opinion.3: Let me tell you that, then. Someone set this whole thing up and I’m counting on you to find out who it was.
a.Power_Station.Honest_opinion.4: You’ve got our word but first, let’s make the station working.
a.Power_Station.Bright_Side.summary: Call us crazy but we never give up and our optimistic worldview definitely helps us with that!
a.Power_Station.Bright_Side.0: I don’t know about you, Firecracker, but we always try to look at everything from the bright side.
a.Power_Station.Bright_Side.2: Yes, it’s bad that the station was caught on fire. But it was a bit outdated anyway. So now we get a chance to make it better.
a.Power_Station.Bright_Side.3: That’s an impressive mindset, Heroes. No wonder the city looks so good these days!
a.Power_Station.Cherished_moment.summary: We all owe Sugar Heroes an unpayable debt but they want nothing in return. That’s why everyone loves them!
a.Power_Station.Cherished_moment.0: By the way, how are things going at the fire station?
a.Power_Station.Cherished_moment.1: Everything is great. We still have a group photo with you hanging on the main wall.
a.Power_Station.Cherished_moment.2: It was our pleasure helping you out and it makes us happy to know that you still remember that moment.
a.Power_Station.Used_opportunity.summary: As we mentioned before it was an opportunity for us to make the power station better and we made sure to take advantage of it!
a.Power_Station.Used_opportunity.0: The Power Station is good as new!
a.Power_Station.Used_opportunity.1: You wanted to say that it’s even better now than when it was initially built.
a.Power_Station.Used_opportunity.2: Yes, that's what I meant. We’ve made some pretty cool additions so even if someone decides to set it on fire again it won’t work.
a.Power_Station.Used_opportunity.3: Thanks again, Heroes! As long as we have you we have nothing to worry about.
a.Glass_Factory.Always_prepared.summary: We’re always ready when anyone needs us. Let’s get started!
a.Glass_Factory.Always_prepared.0: Hi, Heroes! Are you the ones we should thank for fixing the trouble at the power station?
a.Glass_Factory.Always_prepared.1: We were just doing our job. It’s our pleasure to help the citizens out.
a.Glass_Factory.Always_prepared.2: Do you mind giving us a hand at our factory then?
a.Glass_Factory.Always_prepared.3: Not at all. Lead the way!
a.Glass_Factory.Good_hands.summary: This factory may look doomed to a regular citizen but we’ve seen worse. We saved worse. So let’s roll up our sleeves and get to work!
a.Glass_Factory.Good_hands.1: It’s hard to tell at this point. After all the trouble at the water treatment plant and the power station, we don’t know what exactly led to our factory’s shutdown.
a.Glass_Factory.Good_hands.2: It was probably a combination of these factors. Many other businesses were on the edge of bankruptcy but they’re all prospering now. You’re in good hands!
a.Glass_Factory.Next_level.summary: It’s nice to see all these scientists doing their thing. Yes, we can’t help them with formulas but we are the best when it comes to collecting the ingredients.
a.Glass_Factory.Next_level.0: What type of glass are you making here?
a.Glass_Factory.Next_level.1: We were making regular glass but not long before the crisis we started to work on a formula for an armored glass. Your feats inspired us and we wanted to give back.
a.Glass_Factory.Next_level.2: What a coincidence! We might have something that’s going to take your formula to the next level. It’s time to visit the professor.
a.Glass_Factory.Endless_problems.summary: I wonder if there comes a day when Heroes come to me without a problem to solve. Although I hope this day never comes because I enjoy it!
a.Glass_Factory.Endless_problems.0: Welcome back, Heroes! What have you got for me today?
a.Glass_Factory.Endless_problems.1: We want you to take a look at this crystal we’ve got from the mine and find a way to strengthen the armored glass with it.
a.Glass_Factory.Endless_problems.2: I missed helping you solve all these very interesting problems so much. Let’s get to work!
a.Glass_Factory.Right_hands.summary: We were happy to collaborate with Sugar Heroes and Mr. Brain to create this next-generation glass. It will always be here if they ever need it.
a.Glass_Factory.Right_hands.0: I can’t believe it, Heroes! This new formula is fantastic!
a.Glass_Factory.Right_hands.1: Don’t thank us. It was all Mr. Brain.
a.Glass_Factory.Right_hands.2: Let’s agree that everyone played a crucial part in creating this new type of glass. The question is what are we going to do with it?
a.Glass_Factory.Right_hands.3: Don’t worry. It’s in the right hands. We’ll make sure to put it to good use!
a.Furniture_Factory.Fresh_start.summary: Maybe it’s important to know your past but making others present better seems more fulfilling so that’s what we’re going to do.
a.Furniture_Factory.Fresh_start.0: It’s good to be back and just helping the citizens without worrying about anything else.
a.Furniture_Factory.Fresh_start.1: I agree. Maybe we should drop this whole meteorite thing and focus on what’s really important?
a.Furniture_Factory.Fresh_start.2: I think so too! This furniture factory looks like a perfect place to do just that.
a.Furniture_Factory.Let_there_be_light.sum: We’ve been in total darkness lately and having Sugar Heroes feels like seeing a very bright light at the end of the tunnel.
a.Furniture_Factory.Let_there_be_light.0: This place looks pretty deserted for a factory. Aren’t you suppose to make furniture here?
a.Furniture_Factory.Let_there_be_light.1: We are but, you know, in the light of recent events we’ve been having some problems with our finances, resources, and even lighting.
a.Furniture_Factory.Let_there_be_light.2: We know. That’s exactly why we’re here. Give us some time and this place is going to shine!
a.Furniture_Factory.The_confession.summary: Sugar Heroes have been so nice to me so I can no longer lie to them. They deserve to know the truth about this factory!
a.Furniture_Factory.The_confession.0: I can’t thank you enough, Heroes, but I need to admit something to you.
a.Furniture_Factory.The_confession.2: Well, the factory is having trouble now but it wasn’t that successful before either.
a.Furniture_Factory.The_confession.3: It’s good that you came forward because we know just a solution to your problem!
a.Furniture_Factory.All_ears.summary: First Sugar Heroes help me get my sawmill back on track and now they present me with a business opportunity. Is there something they can’t do?
a.Furniture_Factory.All_ears.0: Hi, Jack! We were wondering if you would be kind enough to indulge our favor.
a.Furniture_Factory.All_ears.1: If it’s anything I can do myself consider it's done. If not, I will no rest until I find someone who can help you.
a.Furniture_Factory.All_ears.2: There is no need for that. What we’re about to offer you is limited to your sawmill only. Although it’s risky, the reward might worth it.
a.Furniture_Factory.Infinite_gratitude.sum: I’m not sure if I’ll ever be able to return a favor to Sugar Heroes. They’ve done so much for me and I’ll forever be obliged to them.
a.Furniture_Factory.Infinite_gratitude.0: Good news! We’ve found you a new timber supplier who is willing to provide you with materials for free until you start making enough profit to pay for it. How do you like the sound of that?
a.Furniture_Factory.Infinite_gratitude.1: I can’t believe my ears, Heroes! That is the best thing anyone ever did to me.
a.Furniture_Factory.Infinite_gratitude.2: We’re glad to hear that. You’ll be able to get back to furniture making very soon.
a.Greenhouse.Intriguing_question.summary: I don’t usually ask Sugar Heroes for help. Especially not when it comes to plants. Only this time I have no choice.
a.Greenhouse.Intriguing_question.1: We’re fine, Mr. Green, thank you. It’s strange to see you come to us. Usually, it’s the other way round. Is everything okay?
a.Greenhouse.Intriguing_question.2: I wish I could say so. My niece is an aspiring agronomist and she approached me with a question that I was hoping you’ll help me answer.
a.Greenhouse.Intriguing_question.3: You know that we're always up for a challenge!
a.Greenhouse.Rose_Green.summary: I’ve encountered something really strange and since the Sugar Heroes are the ones who specialize in strange I immediately reached out to them.
a.Greenhouse.Rose_Green.0: Hi, Heroes! My name is Rose. My uncle told me so much about you. It’s a real honor.
a.Greenhouse.Rose_Green.1: It’s nice to meet you too, Rose. Why don’t you tell us about your discovery?
a.Greenhouse.Rose_Green.2: Well, I’ve been studying different plants for my dissertation when they all started beaming with green light like some beacons.
a.Greenhouse.Rose_Green.3: The green light, huh? Sounds familiar. I think I know what we should do.
a.Greenhouse.About_time.summary: I think it’s time to share our secret with Mr. Green but let’s confirm it with the professor first.
a.Greenhouse.About_time.0: Mr. Green, we have something that you should see. It might help solve this mystery.
a.Greenhouse.About_time.1: But first, we need to visit Mr. Brain and ask him about it.
a.Greenhouse.About_time.2: Go ahead, Heroes. Rose and I will be waiting for you here.
a.Greenhouse.About_time.3: You’ve been here for a while already. Let us get you some snacks first and we will be on our way.
a.Greenhouse.Mutual_trust.summary: I’ve known Mr. Green for a long time. He helped us a lot and he can be trusted.
a.Greenhouse.Mutual_trust.0: Hi, Mr. Brain! There has been something strange happening at the local plantation. We think it has something to do with the meteorite.
a.Greenhouse.Mutual_trust.1: Hm, interesting. Do you need my help with it?
a.Greenhouse.Mutual_trust.2: Actually, Mr. Green is already on the case. We just need your permission to tell him about the meteorite.
a.Greenhouse.Mutual_trust.3: You can trust him. Go ahead and take the meteorite to him so he can study the incident. I’ll join you later.
a.Greenhouse.Mysterious_connection.summary: I’m glad that Sugar Heroes told me about their origin. It feels like I’m a full-fledged member of the team now.
a.Greenhouse.Mysterious_connection.0: So that’s what amplifies your natural inclination towards helping people and making you so good at it.
a.Greenhouse.Mysterious_connection.1: Pretty much. We don’t know all the details yet but Mr. Brain promised to reveal everything to us soon.
a.Greenhouse.Mysterious_connection.2: I appreciate you telling me this. We’ll study it now to find the connection between the meteorite and plants.
a.Greenhouse.Mysterious_connection.3: Yeah, you and Rose should work your magic while we start cleaning this place up.
a.Greenhouse.Molecular_kinship.summary: We’ll continue to study this peculiar connection while Heroes continue to make our city better. Let’s hope that we’ll find something.
a.Greenhouse.Molecular_kinship.0: Well, there is certainly something to it. The plants have some of the same cells that the meteorite has. They are connected in a way but I need more time to figure out how exactly.
a.Greenhouse.Molecular_kinship.1: Okay, Mr. Green. We’ll go deal with the Power Station fire consequences while you working on that. Let us know when you have something.
a.Greenhouse.Molecular_kinship.2: Thank you, Heroes! Good luck on your journey. Please, be safe.
a.Greenhouse.Molecular_kinship.3: Don’t worry, Rose. We are always prepared for what’s coming our way.
a.Sheep_Farm.Challenge_accepted.summary: We like to challenge ourselves. The only way to grow is to always approach difficult tasks and this is exactly what we are going to do.
