a.Sheep_Farm.Challenge_accepted.0: Do you remember when we went to the apiary and just stood there because we know nothing about the bees?
a.Sheep_Farm.Challenge_accepted.1: Of course. Please don’t make me go there again.
a.Sheep_Farm.Challenge_accepted.2: Everything is okay there now. They don’t need our help. I was thinking about challenging ourselves to a sheep farm.
a.Sheep_Farm.Challenge_accepted.3: I can’t say that I’m a sheep expert but I accept your challenge. Let’s do this!
a.Sheep_Farm.Helping_to_help.summary: If they could, Sugar Heroes would have helped everyone around but it’s physically impossible. And there is always should be someone who helps them.
a.Sheep_Farm.Helping_to_help.0: Sugar Heroes! To what do I owe the pleasure?
a.Sheep_Farm.Helping_to_help.1: Greetings! We’re on our mission to help the citizens deal with the consequences of all these problems our city has been having recently.
a.Sheep_Farm.Helping_to_help.2: We don’t know much about sheep but we’re experts when it comes to troubleshooting. Will you accept our help?
a.Sheep_Farm.Helping_to_help.3: Only if you let me help you help me!
a.Sheep_Farm.United_Force.summary: Everyone sees us as the only reason why our city is getting better but it would’ve been impossible without its brave and friendly citizens.
a.Sheep_Farm.United_Force.0: How many businesses have you already saved?
a.Sheep_Farm.United_Force.1: We didn’t really save them. We just gave their owners a hand so they could get back on their feet.
a.Sheep_Farm.United_Force.2: Well, as you can see there are a lot of feet here. Do you think you can save us all?
a.Sheep_Farm.Dedicated_heart.summary: My mom always said that if you do something do it like it’s the most important thing in your life and eventually it will become one.
a.Sheep_Farm.Dedicated_heart.0: Did I tell you that my sheep are the best in the whole wide world?
a.Sheep_Farm.Dedicated_heart.1: Not yet but it seems like you’re about to do just that.
a.Sheep_Farm.Dedicated_heart.2: It’s funny how wherever we go everyone claims that their stuff is the best and they aren’t lying! What’s the secret?
a.Sheep_Farm.Dedicated_heart.3: There is no secret. We just love what we do and we pour our hearts into doing it. Just like you. And the world gives back.
a.Sheep_Farm.Full_and_happy.summary: My sheep are special. See for yourself by feeding them something sweet. Sugar makes their wool extra soft.
a.Sheep_Farm.Full_and_happy.0: We’re about to finish things up. Is there anything special you would like us to build for your sheep?
a.Sheep_Farm.Full_and_happy.1: It would mean a lot to me if you somehow managed to get them their favorite treats. When they’re happy and full their wool is softer than silk.
a.Sheep_Farm.Full_and_happy.2: Consider it done! We might grab a few snacks for ourselves along the way too. Do you want something?
a.Sheep_Farm.Full_and_happy.3: Some jam would be nice. Thank you!
a.Textile_Factory.Raw_materials.summary: I don’t want to seem rude but I really need some help. If barging in like this is what it takes I have no choice but to do so.
a.Textile_Factory.Raw_materials.0: Hey, Heroes! I just saw you leaving the sheep farm. Is everything okay there?
a.Textile_Factory.Raw_materials.1: It is now. Why do you ask?
a.Textile_Factory.Raw_materials.2: Great! My textile factory can’t go without materials. Do you think you can help me get some?
a.Textile_Factory.Raw_materials.3: We’ll be glad to do that!
a.Textile_Factory.Broken_equipment.summary: I’ve never seen an attitude like this before. They’re much more than mere Heroes. They’re our friends.
a.Textile_Factory.Broken_equipment.0: You mentioned that you only need materials. What are you going to make off of them with broken equipment?
a.Textile_Factory.Broken_equipment.1: You noticed... Yeah, the fire at the power station caused some short-circuiting but it’s my problem now, thank you for your help!
a.Textile_Factory.Broken_equipment.2: Don’t be silly. We came here to help. And if you need more than just materials we’re going to get it.
a.Textile_Factory.Broken_equipment.3: Has anyone named a fabric after you yet? No? Well, I’m going to be the first one!
a.Textile_Factory.Trial_and_error.summary: It took a lot of time and effort to find my vocation. It means a lot to me and Sugar Heroes’ help is priceless!
a.Textile_Factory.Trial_and_error.0: How long have you been in the business?
a.Textile_Factory.Trial_and_error.1: I started as a dressmaker but it didn’t take long for me to realize that I wasn’t good at it.
a.Textile_Factory.Trial_and_error.2: This was the moment when you switched to making fabrics?
a.Textile_Factory.Trial_and_error.3: It took a while before I became who I am right now. Fishing, waiting tables, barbering. You name it. That’s why I care about my factory so much.
a.Textile_Factory.Interesting_idea.summary: We’ve already applied the crystal to glass production. Let’s try it with the fabrics too!
a.Textile_Factory.Interesting_idea.0: Heroes, is there anything you would like me to make specifically for you?
a.Textile_Factory.Interesting_idea.2: I don’t know... A superhero’s cape, for example.
a.Textile_Factory.Interesting_idea.3: Cape is probably going to be too much but we like the idea. Let’s try something!
a.Textile_Factory.Leap_of_faith.summary: Usually, I don’t fall for fishy stories like this. But when Sugar Heroes tell to trust them you have no other choice.
a.Textile_Factory.Leap_of_faith.0: So, you want me to make you something extra-durable by adding the grounded bits of this special crystal into the mix?
a.Textile_Factory.Leap_of_faith.1: Yes. We know it sounds strange but it works. See for yourself.
a.Textile_Factory.Leap_of_faith.2: It might sound crazy coming from someone else but I trust you, Heroes.
a.Textile_Factory.Leap_of_faith.3: Thank you! It’s been an absolute pleasure working alongside you.
a.Jewelery_Store.Out_of_the_blue.summary: I hate to break it to my friends but someone has to do it. Hopefully, they’ll cooperate and help us find Mr. Brain.
a.Jewelery_Store.Out_of_the_blue.0: I was hoping that I’ll never see you again, Heroes. But here we are.
a.Jewelery_Store.Out_of_the_blue.1: Please, don’t say that the Cashier escaped the prison.
a.Jewelery_Store.Out_of_the_blue.2: No, he is quite safe in that fortress that you’ve built. There’s been a robbery.
a.Jewelery_Store.Out_of_the_blue.3: Thank you for thinking of us. We would like to help you solve this case.
a.Jewelery_Store.Out_of_the_blue.4: Unfortunately, I had no choice. It was Mr. Brain who committed the crime.
a.Jewelery_Store.Search_for_the_answers.su: We can’t possibly believe that the professor did it. We need to do something to prove his innocence.
a.Jewelery_Store.Search_for_the_answers.0: Welcome to my store, Heroes. I would rather have you here under different circumstances but I’m afraid we have no choice.
a.Jewelery_Store.Search_for_the_answers.1: We’re really sorry about what happened but we refuse to believe that Mr. Brain is responsible for it.
a.Jewelery_Store.Search_for_the_answers.2: His prints are all over the scene and the fact that he is nowhere to be found doesn’t help.
a.Jewelery_Store.Search_for_the_answers.3: We’re going to fix everything but first, we would like to search the laboratory if you let us.
a.Jewelery_Store.Search_for_the_answers.4: Sure, go ahead. Let me know if you find anything.
a.Jewelery_Store.Glimmer_of_hope.summary: As long as we’re out there looking for the truth there is a chance to turn everything around. We must never stop.
a.Jewelery_Store.Glimmer_of_hope.0: We need to do whatever it takes to clears the professor’s name.
a.Jewelery_Store.Glimmer_of_hope.1: Don’t worry, Ed. We will. Let’s focus on finding any clues first.
a.Jewelery_Store.Glimmer_of_hope.2: Let’s hope that he saw it coming and that he left us a note or something.
a.Jewelery_Store.Staying_true.summary: Even if everyone tells you otherwise you have to listen to your heart first. That’s what the professor taught us and that’s what we do.
a.Jewelery_Store.Staying_true.0: We couldn’t find anything at the laboratory, Magnum. Maybe there is something at the hospital or university.
a.Jewelery_Store.Staying_true.1: Go ahead, Heroes. Although, don’t get your hopes up. I know it must be hard for you to believe in this but facts speak for themselves.
a.Jewelery_Store.Staying_true.2: Mr. Brain always taught us to listen to our hearts first. And they’re telling that he is innocent. We’re going to prove it!
a.Jewelery_Store.Keeping_promises.summary: Before we continue our search for the answers we need to repair the store as we promised.
a.Jewelery_Store.Keeping_promises.1: Nothing. We feel really bad. As we said before, we’re going to help you repair the damage.
a.Jewelery_Store.Keeping_promises.2: It’s okay, Heroes. My store was insured. You don’t have to worry.
a.Jewelery_Store.Keeping_promises.3: No. We don’t want the news to be out. Please, let us help you but don’t tell anyone about the professor yet.
a.Jewelery_Store.Keeping_promises.4: Okay, Heroes. You have my word.
a.City_Hall.The_Earthquake.summary: Maybe this city doesn't deserve Sugar Heroes considering how many bad things are happening to it. Without them, though, it’s going to be the end of it.
a.City_Hall.The_Earthquake.0: Hi, Heroes! Sorry for bothering you again but we have a very urgent matter at hand.
a.City_Hall.The_Earthquake.1: Sure, no problem. We’ll be glad to help. What is it?
a.City_Hall.The_Earthquake.2: There was an earthquake but it only affected certain areas of the city which is highly unusual. We believe that someone was behind it. The mayor wants to see you for a briefing.
a.City_Hall.The_Earthquake.3: This someone caused the city enough problems. It about time we stop him!
a.City_Hall.The_briefing.summary: I’m happy to welcome Sugar Heroes at my residence and hope that they feel like home here despite the recent events.
a.City_Hall.The_briefing.0: Hello, Heroes! It’s nice to see you. Thank you for meeting me and for all you’ve done for your city.
a.City_Hall.The_briefing.1: Are you okay, sir? We see that the City Hall was a villain’s targets. We’ll do our best to fix it.
a.City_Hall.The_briefing.2: I’m fine, Heroes. I’m glad to hear that you’re ready to put a stop to it all. Although, there is something I need to tell you before we begin.
a.City_Hall.The_briefing.3: Of course, sir. It’s our duty to protect the city and its citizens.
a.City_Hall.Unexpected_confidant.summary: I’ve been keeping an eye on Sugar Heroes ever since they were created. They’re our only hope now and I’m sure they’ll succeed.
a.City_Hall.Unexpected_confidant.0: You might know that a few years ago a meteorite landed in our city.
a.City_Hall.Unexpected_confidant.1: Yes, we might’ve heard something about it.
a.City_Hall.Unexpected_confidant.2: It’s okay, Heroes. I’m aware of your origin. I myself gave Mr. Brain permission to keep one of the pieces and to train you.
a.City_Hall.Unexpected_confidant.3: Thank you, sir. We just try to be cautious. Especially since the professor went missing.
a.City_Hall.Unexpected_confidant.4: I know. That’s why I wanted to see you.
a.City_Hall.Third_piece.summary: I know that it's a lot to ask but Heroes already stopped the villain from stealing the meteorite so they can do it again.
a.City_Hall.Third_piece.0: When we extracted the meteorite we split it into three pieces: one went to the professor, one to the bureau of investigation, and one was kept in the bank but we moved it here after the cashier tried to rob it.
a.City_Hall.Third_piece.1: Cashier robbing the bank was just a way for the real villain to distract us from what was actually happening? He wanted the third piece.
a.City_Hall.Third_piece.2: You were able to prevent that and secure the meteorite without even knowing it. But as you probably guessed from the ruins around you the villain finally managed to get what he wanted.
a.City_Hall.Key_to_the_city.summary: If there is any way for me to help Sugar Heroes it is to grant them this key to the city. All the doors are open now!
a.City_Hall.Key_to_the_city.0: Sir, we’ll make things right. You have our word. Once we’re done rebuilding the City Hall we’ll catch the villain and bring the meteorite back. In the meantime, you can have our piece.
a.City_Hall.Key_to_the_city.1: Thank you, Heroes. I know you will. I would suggest you go to the TV station afterwards. They also need help plus there should be some footage that might help your investigation.
a.City_Hall.Key_to_the_city.2: That’s actually very good advice. We’ll definitely do that.
a.City_Hall.Key_to_the_city.3: I would also like to give you the key that can open every door in the city. This way nothing will stand in your way!
a.TV_Station.Cause_and_effect.summary: We all know Sugar Heroes perfectly well. They are the reason we have our job.
a.TV_Station.Cause_and_effect.0: Hello! We’re Sugar Heroes and we came to rescue you.
a.TV_Station.Cause_and_effect.1: We know perfectly well who you are. You make news and we broadcast them.
a.TV_Station.Cause_and_effect.2: And we thank you for that! The Mayor told us that your building was also impacted.
a.TV_Station.Cause_and_effect.3: Yes, come with me. I’ll show you around.
a.TV_Station.To_each_his_own.summary: I believe that everyone should do their job. Someone is good at flexing the muscles, someone at flexing the brain.
a.TV_Station.To_each_his_own.0: We’ve seen enough. There is no doubt that the station was severely damaged.
a.TV_Station.To_each_his_own.1: It’ll take a while for us to rebuilt it. In the meantime, can you please go through the security footage. Maybe it will help us find out who is behind all that.
a.TV_Station.To_each_his_own.2: Sure, no problem. If you’ll need any help with the construction don’t bother asking me. I’m no use when it comes to physical labor.
a.TV_Station.To_each_his_own.3: Thank you, I guess. Don’t worry, we’ve got this.
a.TV_Station.Seed_of_doubt.summary: Maybe we’re mistaken and there is nothing wrong with the reporter but we need to make sure of that.
a.TV_Station.Seed_of_doubt.0: This reporter seems a bit strange, don’t you think?
a.TV_Station.Seed_of_doubt.1: Yeah, something is not right about him. Maybe one of us should carry on with the renovation while the other is looking after the reporter.
a.TV_Station.Seed_of_doubt.2: You go and do that. I'll stay here and work on turning this building into an even better version of itself.
a.TV_Station.Airtight_Alibi.summary: Well, it seems like everything is okay and all our worries were in vain. Let’s just hope that we’ll get some intel on the potential suspect.
a.TV_Station.Airtight_Alibi.1: Almost done. Did you manage to find out anything?
a.TV_Station.Airtight_Alibi.2: No. He was actually looking through the footage the whole time. I’m sorry I wasted our time. I’d rather help you.
a.TV_Station.Airtight_Alibi.3: It’s okay. We had to make sure. Now we can finish things off together and hope to hear some good news from the reporter.
a.TV_Station.Immutable_Resilience.summary: We didn’t get lucky with the footage but it doesn’t mean that we’re going to give up. We’ll just focus on helping citizens for now.
a.TV_Station.Immutable_Resilience.0: Thank you for your help, Heroes. I’ve looked through all the recordings we had prior to the earthquake and after that but found nothing.
a.TV_Station.Immutable_Resilience.1: Well, at least you tried. It’s very much appreciated.
a.TV_Station.Immutable_Resilience.2: We’ll continue to restore the affected buildings. Maybe there are clues there. If you have any updates on the case, please, let us know.
a.Diner.Empty_Stomach.summary: We’ve spent a lot of time helping the city and snacks are not enough anymore. It’s time to sit down and have a nice meal.
a.Diner.Empty_Stomach.0: You know, Ed, this whole building renovation made me a little hungry.
a.Diner.Empty_Stomach.1: I can definitely relate to that, Billie.
a.Diner.Empty_Stomach.2: I bet there is a diner somewhere that was damaged by the earthquake. I think if we help the owner to rebuild it he’ll thank us with something delicious.
a.Diner.Empty_Stomach.3: I like your thinking! Let’s grab some tools and find someone in need.
a.Diner.Operation_“Preparation”.summary: I can’t even tell the last time Sugar Heroes had something to eat. We should hurry up. Their nutrition levels are way down!
a.Diner.Operation_“Preparation”.0: Hi there! We have a proposition for you.
a.Diner.Operation_“Preparation”.1: Hello, Heroes! You want me to cook you something while you rebuilt my diner?
a.Diner.Operation_“Preparation”.2: That’s exactly what we had in mind! How did you know?
a.Diner.Operation_“Preparation”.3: Food is everything to me. I can spot a hungry person from miles away. Although, I don’t have any ingredients left. The earthquake destroyed them all.
a.Diner.Operation_“Preparation”.4: Don’t worry! Getting things is our specialty. We’ll see you in a jiffy.
a.Diner.New_experience.summary: We were introduced to a very interesting concept of relaxation and we would like to try it out. Let’s see where it get us!
a.Diner.New_experience.0: Thank you for all the products, Heroes! Just give me time to make something of it.
a.Diner.New_experience.1: Great! We’ll start working on the renovation then.
a.Diner.New_experience.2: I don’t think it’s a good idea. Have you ever tried to relax? Do nothing until the meal is ready and see how it feels like.
a.Diner.New_experience.3: Sounds interesting but we can’t just be idle. How about walking around the city and getting something to drink?
a.Diner.Full_Tank.summary: It feels nice to relax but it feels even better to be full! We are ready to act.
a.Diner.Full_Tank.0: That was really nice! Thank you for the advice. We enjoyed our rest.
a.Diner.Full_Tank.1: And thank you for the meal, it’s delicious!
a.Diner.Full_Tank.2: You’re welcome, Heroes. This is the least I can do.
a.Diner.Full_Tank.3: Now let’s get to work and rebuild your diner!
a.Diner.Elevating_feeling.summary: My diner is about to be back in the business all thanks to Sugar Heroes! What an elevating feeling!
a.Diner.Elevating_feeling.0: It was our pleasure to taste your cooking and help you deal with the damage!
a.Diner.Elevating_feeling.1: We wish your diner prosperity. Especially since it looks even nicer than before.
a.Diner.Elevating_feeling.2: Thank you, Heroes. It does look better indeed.
a.Rubber_Plant.Another_Quest.summary: We're ready to continue our quest to help the citizens!
a.Rubber_Plant.Another_Quest.0: Hi Heroes! I've heard that you're once again on a run to help the affected business.
a.Rubber_Plant.Another_Quest.1: That's right! And we are about to help you.
a.Rubber_Plant.Thankful_Citizen.summary: We like being appreciated but it's too early to jump to conclusions yet.
a.Rubber_Plant.Thankful_Citizen.0: Thank you so much for helping me out.
a.Rubber_Plant.Thankful_Citizen.1: Don't thank us yet. Wait until we're done.
a.Rubber_Plant.Lost_Count.summary: We like to think that we've made our city a better place and we never intend to stop!
a.Rubber_Plant.Lost_Count.0: How many factories have you saved so far?
a.Rubber_Plant.Lost_Count.1: We don't really think about numbers. We just want to make sure that our city is full of happy citizens.
a.Rubber_Plant.Rich_History.summary: We've been making rubber goods for many years and we hope to continue doing that.
a.Rubber_Plant.Rich_History.0: Were you always involved in rubber production?
a.Rubber_Plant.Rich_History.1: Yes. Our factory produces the best quality rubber in town due to our rich experience. Feel free to use our products afterward.
a.Rubber_Plant.Welcoming_Goodbye.summary: Sugar Heroes helped us a lot and they'll be always welcomed back!
a.Rubber_Plant.Welcoming_Goodbye.0: Well, we're almost finished. It was our pleasure to help you.
a.Rubber_Plant.Welcoming_Goodbye.1: Thank you. Feel free to come back anytime!
a.Plastic_Factory.Helping_Hand.summary: Let's go and help someone else!
a.Plastic_Factory.Helping_Hand.0: Hi there! It looks like you might need some help.
a.Plastic_Factory.Helping_Hand.1: It will be very much appreciated. I love what you've done with the Rubber Plant.
a.Plastic_Factory.Unequivocal_Outcome.summ: We believe in hard work so everything is possible!
a.Plastic_Factory.Unequivocal_Outcome.0: Do you think it's even possible to repair our factory?
a.Plastic_Factory.Unequivocal_Outcome.1: We are Sugar Heroes. Everything is possible when it comes to helping the city!
a.Plastic_Factory.Future_Demand.summary: Sugar Heroes are the best! I can't wait to see what they come up with.
a.Plastic_Factory.Future_Demand.0: Is there any way I can help you?
a.Plastic_Factory.Future_Demand.1: You can just relax. You need to be well-rested when the factory is working again because of all the demand.
a.Plastic_Factory.Truth_Digging.summary: I think I talk too much. I should just let them do their job.
a.Plastic_Factory.Truth_Digging.0: Is it clear yet what caused all this mess?
a.Plastic_Factory.Truth_Digging.1: Unfortunately, no. But we'll get to the bottom of this all.
a.Plastic_Factory.Favorite_Job.summary: This is fantastic! The outcome is even better than I expected!
a.Plastic_Factory.Favorite_Job.0: I don't know what to say, Heroes! The factory is about to start working again. All thanks to you!
a.Plastic_Factory.Favorite_Job.1: We're just doing our job. And when you love what you do it comes effortlessly.
a.Steel_mill.Exciting_Streak.summary: It feels nice to do good deeds so let's not stop!
a.Steel_mill.Exciting_Streak.0: I'm enjoying our helping streak so far, Ed! Are you ready to save another building?
a.Steel_mill.Exciting_Streak.1: I was born ready, Billie! Let's take everything we might need there and get to work.
a.Steel_mill.Fearless_Approach.summary: We will always welcome a challenge in our lives!
a.Steel_mill.Fearless_Approach.0: We're so happy that you're here, Heroes! We desperately need your help.
a.Steel_mill.Fearless_Approach.1: It looks like a lot of work but we were never afraid of challenges!
a.Steel_mill.Only_Hope.summary: We never give up. Especially not when things get more complicated.
a.Steel_mill.Only_Hope.0: It is a bit harder than we expected but we will restore your Mill!
a.Steel_mill.Only_Hope.1: Thank you, Heroes. If you won't do it nobody will.
a.Steel_mill.Long-term_Favor.summary: Sugar Heroes don't need to ask for permission. They can always take what they need!
a.Steel_mill.Long-term_Favor.0: Do you mind if we borrow some equipment from your factory in the future?
a.Steel_mill.Long-term_Favor.1: Not at all. It will be our pleasure to share what we have with you.
a.Steel_mill.Open_Doors.summary: It's been a dream to watch Sugar Heroes help us with our factory!
a.Steel_mill.Open_Doors.0: We're almost done. Let's hope that with all these renovated equipment your steel will become better than ever!
a.Steel_mill.Open_Doors.1: Thank you! Our doors will be always open to you, Heroes.
a.Paint_Factory.Non-stop.summary: We won't stop until every factory is functioning again.
a.Paint_Factory.Non-stop.0: I can see another damaged factory from here.
a.Paint_Factory.Untold_Happiness.summary: Sugar Heroes are here to help and we couldn't be happier!
a.Paint_Factory.Untold_Happiness.0: Thanks for stopping by, Heroes! Will you help us?
a.Paint_Factory.Untold_Happiness.1: Of course. That's what we do best.
a.Paint_Factory.City_Saviours.summary: Let's do our best to save another factory!
a.Paint_Factory.City_Saviours.0: It's tough but we enjoy what we do.
a.Paint_Factory.Finish_Line.summary: We're on the finish line so we can't stop.
a.Paint_Factory.Finish_Line.0: We're almost there! Few more things and it will be as good as new.
a.Paint_Factory.Invaluable_Contribution.su: I can only thank Sugar heroes for their invaluable contribution!
a.Paint_Factory.Invaluable_Contribution.0: Thank you so much, Sugar Heroes!
a.Paint_Factory.Invaluable_Contribution.1: Not at all. It's our job and we intend to keep doing it.
a.Automotive_Factory.Curiosity_Stream.summ: This factory also needs our help. Let's provide it!
a.Automotive_Factory.Curiosity_Stream.0: It's getting more interesting with each factory. Let's see what else we can do!
a.Automotive_Factory.Managing_Expectations: Sugar Heroes can't fail. Our factory will be working again!
Sugar Heroes are here! We are saved!
Please, don't get your hopes up just yet. We'll try our best.
a.Automotive_Factory.Work_in_progress.summ: Sugar Heroes can rely on me as much as I can rely on them.
a.Automotive_Factory.Work_in_progress.0: You're doing so great, Sugar Heroes! I'll be there if you need me.
a.Automotive_Factory.Almost_there.summary: Help and appreciation from the citizens are equally important as our labor.
a.Automotive_Factory.Almost_there.0: Thank you for your support. We're almost finished.
a.Automotive_Factory.Fast_and_faster.summa: Sugar Heroes are amazing! I wish we could work as fast.
a.Automotive_Factory.Fast_and_faster.0: Just give us some extra time and our factory will start making vehicles again!
a.Automotive_Factory.Fast_and_faster.1: Great news, Sugar Heroes! You work even faster than our most rapid cars.
a.Shipyard.Damage_Assessment.summary: It's not actually a factory but a shipyard although the same rules should apply.
a.Shipyard.Damage_Assessment.0: Hi, Heroes! Can you, please, help us out too?
a.Shipyard.Damage_Assessment.1: Sure! Take us to your factory so we could assess the situation first.
a.Shipyard.Music_to_ears.summary: This is a perfect example of why Sugar Heroes are so beloved!
a.Shipyard.Music_to_ears.0: Yeah, we can see that it has suffered a lot but we can save it.
a.Shipyard.Music_to_ears.1: This is the best thing I've ever heard.
a.Shipyard.Under_control.summary: I know that Sugar Heroes can do everything themselves but I'm just being polite.
a.Shipyard.Under_control.0: Do you need my help with anything?
a.Shipyard.Under_control.1: No, thank you. Everything is under control.
a.Shipyard.Extra_Equipment.summary: We need some extra equipment and luckily we know where to get it.
a.Shipyard.Extra_Equipment.0: We're a little short on the equipment so we'll have to grab a few things before continuing.
a.Shipyard.Optical_Illusion.summary: What seems impossible to an ordinary citizen is just another thing to accomplish for Sugar Heroes!
a.Shipyard.Optical_Illusion.0: It seemed like a lot of work in the beginning but now we're almost done.
a.Shipyard.Optical_Illusion.1: It's because you're the best at what you do. Thank you, Heroes!
a.Chemical_Plant.Using_Momentum.summary: We should strike while the iron is hot. It's time to save the next building!
a.Chemical_Plant.Using_Momentum.0: We have done a pretty good job at the shipyard. Let's use the momentum to save the Chemical Plant!
a.Chemical_Plant.Friendly_Welcome.summary: Any students of my friend are welcome here. Especially Sugar Heroes!
a.Chemical_Plant.Friendly_Welcome.0: Greetings, Sugar Heroes! I've heard so much about you.
a.Chemical_Plant.Friendly_Welcome.1: It's an honor for us to meet you. Mr. Brain told us a lot about your plant.
a.Chemical_Plant.Friendly_Welcome.2: We will do our best to save it!
a.Chemical_Plant.Warm-Up.summary: We're just getting started but everything looks very promising!
a.Chemical_Plant.Warm-Up.0: Professor taught you well. You're doing a great job.
a.Chemical_Plant.Warm-Up.1: Thank you but we are just warming up.
a.Chemical_Plant.Fight_for_Justice.summary: It's hard to balance between saving the city and Mr. Brain but we intend to do both!
a.Chemical_Plant.Fight_for_Justice.0: It's very unfortunate what happened to Mr. Brain.
a.Chemical_Plant.Fight_for_Justice.1: Yes. It's our mission to prove his innocence.
a.Chemical_Plant.Fight_for_Justice.2: Let me know if you need any help!
a.Chemical_Plant.Saving_the_City.summary: We're lucky to have Sugar Heroes! I hope that they succeed with everything they try to accomplish.
a.Chemical_Plant.Saving_the_City.0: You did great restoring the plant. How can I thank you?
a.Chemical_Plant.Saving_the_City.1: Just keep doing what you do best and we'll carry on with rebuilding the rest of the city.
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Great_Idea.summary: Working in a team is the best because at least one of us always has ideas!
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Great_Idea.0: How about taking the lessons we've learned while rebuilding the Chemical Plant and apply them to saving the Cosmetics Factory?
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Related_Fields.summary: I never let anyone interfere with our equipment but if I were to change this policy it would be for Sugar Heroes.
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Related_Fields.0: Hi there! We would love to help you save your factory.
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Related_Fields.1: I appreciate it but do you know anything about cosmetics?
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Related_Fields.2: No, but we know a thing or two about chemistry now so it should be fine.
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Unnerving_Anticipation: I trust Sugar Heroes but it just takes time to adjust to this new reality of someone else interacting with my equipment.
Is there anything I can do to help you?
Don't worry, we know what we're doing and you have nothing to be concerned about.
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Double_Efforts.summary: We want everyone to feel comfortable with what we do so let's save the factory owner her sleep!
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Double_Efforts.0: We should probably hurry before Coco has a nervous breakdown.
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Double_Efforts.1: These are exactly my thoughts. It's time to double our efforts!
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Right_Decision.summary: I couldn't be happier about how everything turned out to be! Sugar Heroes are the best!
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Right_Decision.0: I'm so glad that you showed up and convinced me to let you help us.
a.Cosmetics_Factory.Right_Decision.1: It was our pleasure. Don't hesitate to ask if you need any help in the future.
a.Perfume_Factory.Smell_of_Adventure.summa: We're about to embark on yet another mission so we better be ready!
a.Perfume_Factory.Smell_of_Adventure.2: I sense another adventure coming our way. Let's get ready!
a.Perfume_Factory.Fragrant_Ruins.summary: Soon our factory will not only smell nice but look beautiful too!
a.Perfume_Factory.Fragrant_Ruins.0: Hello, Sugar Heroes! How did you find us?
a.Perfume_Factory.Fragrant_Ruins.1: Your factory is very fragrant although it needs some help...
a.Perfume_Factory.Fragrant_Ruins.2: And we are here to provide it!
a.Perfume_Factory.Premature_Enthusiasm.sum: I couldn't be more excited about working together with Sugar Heroes! The factory is safe in their hands.
a.Perfume_Factory.Premature_Enthusiasm.0: I'm so happy that you're here. I'll dedicate my next perfume to you!
a.Perfume_Factory.Premature_Enthusiasm.1: We appreciate your enthusiasm but we still have a lot of work ahead of us.
a.Perfume_Factory.Special_Talent.summary: Nothing makes us feel better than helping others realize their talents!
a.Perfume_Factory.Special_Talent.0: Were you always good at producing scents?
a.Perfume_Factory.Special_Talent.1: I guess I just have a special talent...
a.Perfume_Factory.Special_Talent.2: We'll do our best so you get back to utilizing it as soon as possible!
a.Perfume_Factory.Back_in_Business.summary: I can't wait to start working on yet another aroma!
a.Perfume_Factory.Back_in_Business.0: You'll be able to start producing fragrances again in no time!
a.Perfume_Factory.Back_in_Business.1: Thank you, Sugar Heroes! Feel free to come back any time you want.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Thorough_Preparat: Many buildings need saving. One by one we'll rescue them all!
I know just a place but let's grab some things first!
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Workaholism.summa: I hope that Heroes won't need my help because I need to finish working on the vaccine.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Workaholism.1: Hi, Phil. We're here to rebuild your factory.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Workaholism.2: Oh, right! I was so busy developing a vaccine that I forgot it was destroyed.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Important_Project: My prayers were heard! We should all focus on what we do best.
Do you need my help, guys?
No, Phil, you can keep working on your project.
Thank you, guys. You're the best!
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.School_Memories.s: Phil was always passionate about his work. That makes two of us.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.School_Memories.0: So, how do you know Phil?
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.School_Memories.1: We went to school together. As you can see he was a much better student.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Many_Friends.summ: It's not a perfect reason to visit your old friends but it's as good as it gets now.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Many_Friends.0: Actually, I also have some friends from school who work at factories too.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Many_Friends.1: Great! Let's visit them after we're done here.
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Great_Promise.sum: Sugar Heroes' feat should not remain unnoticed. They shall forever have my support!
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Great_Promise.0: We're happy to inform you that we're almost done renovating your factory, Phil!
a.Pharmaceutical_Factory.Great_Promise.1: Thank you, guys! When I finally invent the elixir of youth you'll be the first ones to have it!
a.Appliances_Factory.Recharging.summary: It's important to take a break once in a while to avoid burnout.
a.Appliances_Factory.Recharging.0: Do you want to grab a bite before embarking on our next mission?
a.Appliances_Factory.Recharging.1: Sure! We need strength if we want to keep the pace.
a.Appliances_Factory.Good_Old_Billie.summa: Billie was always straight to business type. It's hard not to admire his dedication.
a.Appliances_Factory.Good_Old_Billie.0: Oh my god, Billie! It's so nice to see you.
a.Appliances_Factory.Good_Old_Billie.1: Hi Bob! It's nice to see you too. Can you show us around and tell us what was damaged?
a.Appliances_Factory.Good_Old_Billie.2: You didn't change at all. Follow me!
a.Appliances_Factory.Safe_Harbour.summary: I'm so glad that even after all these years Billie doesn't forget about his friends.
a.Appliances_Factory.Safe_Harbour.0: The damage is bad but it's nothing we can't deal with.
a.Appliances_Factory.Safe_Harbour.1: I always knew that I could count on you no matter what!
a.Appliances_Factory.Alma_Mater.summary: Our school gave us a lot so it would be nice to preserve it too.
a.Appliances_Factory.Alma_Mater.0: By the way, when was the last time you visited our school?
a.Appliances_Factory.Alma_Mater.2: It has also suffered from the earthquake.
a.Appliances_Factory.Another_Reference.sum: After the delicious meal we had earlier we now have enough energy and enthusiasm to help everyone!
a.Appliances_Factory.Another_Reference.0: Thanks for letting me know about the school. We'll take care of after we're done with your factory.
a.Appliances_Factory.Another_Reference.1: Thank you, guys. If you have some time left, maybe you can also help my good pal Peter from the Computer Factory.
a.Appliances_Factory.Another_Reference.2: Sure! Just give us his address and we will be on our way.
a.Computer_Factory.System_Overload.summary: For the first time in my life, someone is going to help me and not the other way round. I need to reboot my brain to comprehend it.
a.Computer_Factory.System_Overload.0: Hello there? We're looking for Peter.
a.Computer_Factory.System_Overload.1: That would be me! How can I help you?
a.Computer_Factory.System_Overload.2: By telling us how can we help you!
a.Computer_Factory.Dealing_with_the_conseq: It's still hard to wrap my head around it but the presence of external support starts to sink in.
Are you sure you want to help me?
Of course. Nobody should deal with the consequences of an earthquake alone.
a.Computer_Factory.The_Community.summary: Maybe I should rethink my approach to life and start paying more attention.
a.Computer_Factory.The_Community.0: How do you even know about me?
a.Computer_Factory.The_Community.1: Bob from the Appliances Factory mentioned that your factory was also affected.
a.Computer_Factory.The_Community.2: Wow! I know Bob but I had no idea that he knows me too!
a.Computer_Factory.Tech_Guy.summary: A chance to work with Sugar Heroes? I can't think of anything better!
a.Computer_Factory.Tech_Guy.0: It's great what you do. I wish I could be more like you!
a.Computer_Factory.Tech_Guy.1: Well, maybe we'll have something for you. Every team needs a tech guy.
a.Computer_Factory.Tech_Guy.2: Are you serious? That would be awesome!
a.Computer_Factory.So_long.summary: Sugar Heroes saved my factory and now I can't wait for a chance to pay them back!
a.Computer_Factory.So_long.0: It was really nice to meet you, Peter.
a.Computer_Factory.So_long.1: Thank you! I'll be waiting for your call. Or message. Or letter.
a.Computer_Factory.So_long.2: Don't worry. We will come when we need you!
a.Ceramics_Factory.Before_class.summary: The school is not going anywhere. Let's help others on our way there!
a.Ceramics_Factory.Before_class.0: Do you think we can save a couple of other factories before going to your school?
a.Ceramics_Factory.Before_class.1: Of course! The city is still full of enterprises that need our help.
a.Ceramics_Factory.Passing_By.summary: It's so nice of Sugar Heroes to stop by and help us!
a.Ceramics_Factory.Passing_By.0: Hello, Heroes! It's nice to see you in our neck of the woods.
a.Ceramics_Factory.Passing_By.1: We were passing by and saw that you might need some help. Let's get to work!
a.Ceramics_Factory.Simple_Secret.summary: There is no special ingredient. We just care about people.
a.Ceramics_Factory.Simple_Secret.0: I must say, your products look really good. What's the secret?
a.Ceramics_Factory.Simple_Secret.1: I guess it's the same as yours. We just love what we do.
a.Ceramics_Factory.Impossible_to_break.sum: Some might think that durable ceramics is bad for business but we are always open to innovations!
a.Ceramics_Factory.Impossible_to_break.0: We want to help you take your ceramics to the next level by making them unbreakable!
a.Ceramics_Factory.Impossible_to_break.1: Thank you so much. Our customers will be very happy.
a.Ceramics_Factory.Everlasting_products.su: I owe Sugar Heroes big time. Without them, it would have been impossible!
a.Ceramics_Factory.Everlasting_products.0: Congratulations! The minute you launch your factory it will start making everlasting products!
a.Toys_Factory.Ingenious_Plan.summary: It's a great plan which allows us to kill two birds with one stone.
a.Toys_Factory.Ingenious_Plan.0: I have an idea! Let's stop at the toy factory on our way to school.
a.Toys_Factory.Ingenious_Plan.1: So we can help them out and get some presents?
a.Toys_Factory.Amazing_news.summary: I've worked at this factory for a very long time and I've never been more excited!
a.Toys_Factory.Amazing_news.0: Hi everyone! We came here to rescue your factory.
a.Toys_Factory.Amazing_news.1: That is the best bit of news I've heard in a very long time!
a.Toys_Factory.Saving_lives.summary: I wouldn't know what to do with my life if it weren't for Sugar Heroes.
a.Toys_Factory.Saving_lives.0: We must say that you've done an incredible job with the factory.
a.Toys_Factory.Saving_lives.1: It means a lot coming from you, Heroes. This factory is my life and you're saving it.
a.Toys_Factory.True_calling.summary: I feel so happy because I do what I've always wanted to do. It's a true blessing!
a.Toys_Factory.True_calling.0: How long have you been working here?
a.Toys_Factory.True_calling.1: I didn't have a fun childhood so I always wanted to make other kids happy. I started to work here part-time when I was at school.
a.Toys_Factory.Rare_favor.summary: It feels strange to ask something in return but Teddy makes it feel quite natural.
a.Toys_Factory.Rare_favor.0: Is there any way I could return the favor?
a.Toys_Factory.Rare_favor.1: Actually, we're going to my school and it would be nice to cheer students up with some toys...
a.Toys_Factory.Rare_favor.2: Say no more! My factory is at your service.
a.School.First_Grade.summary: It's so nice to see Billie all grown up. I can't wait to hear about his life!
a.School.First_Grade.0: Oh my God, Billie! Is that you?
a.School.First_Grade.1: Yes, Mrs. Watson. We're here to save the school.
a.School.Little_Cupcake.summary: Billie is all grown up now but for me, he will always be a cute little cupcake!
a.School.Little_Cupcake.0: Look at you, Billie, you're so strong now! I remember when you were just a little cupcake.
a.School.Little_Cupcake.1: Thank you, Mrs. Watson. I'm as strong as my team. If you don't mind, we'll continue working.
a.School.Little_Cupcake.2: Okay, Little Cupcake, I'll go and make you some tea.
a.School.Going_Crazy.summary: I love Mrs. Watson but she can be too much sometimes...
a.School.Going_Crazy.0: I think I know how I'm going to call you from now on, Little Cup...
a.School.Going_Crazy.1: Please don't! If I hear it one more time I'll lose my mind.
a.School.Going_Crazy.2: Alright, alright. Let's wrap things up.
a.School.Mini_Roll.summary: Nice people have nice friends. These two adorable boys are living proof of that!
a.School.Mini_Roll.0: We're almost done, Mrs. Watson. Thank you for the tea. You're very kind.
a.School.Mini_Roll.1: You're very welcome! Billie, who is that charming mini roll?
a.School.Mini_Roll.2: It's my friend Ed. He is a charming mini roll indeed!
a.School.Busy_schedule.summary: I was happy to see Billie and his friend. I'm honored that I was his teacher once.
a.School.Busy_schedule.0: Well, Mrs. Watson, we're almost done. Thank you for your hospitality! We'll be on our way soon!
a.School.Busy_schedule.1: Do you have to go, my little boys?
a.School.Busy_schedule.2: Yes, absolutely! We're so busy! Let's get to work, Billie!
a.Kindergarten.New_opportunity.summary: We're so glad that the citizens reach out to us themselves because it's hard to keep track of everyone who needs help.
a.Kindergarten.New_opportunity.0: Excuse me, I saw you leaving the local school just now. Maybe you can also help our kindergarten?
a.Kindergarten.New_opportunity.1: Yes, of course. It will be our pleasure!
a.Kindergarten.Bad_timing.summary: Unfortunately, it was not the best time to start the business but I love what I do and I wouldn't have had it any other way.
a.Kindergarten.Bad_timing.0: When we were kids there were no such facilities in the area.
a.Kindergarten.Bad_timing.1: It's sad but it's true. Our institution was opened just a couple of months ago.
a.Kindergarten.Bad_timing.2: Wow, right before all these started happening. Don't worry, we'll take care of it!
a.Kindergarten.Sharing_love.summary: I'm perfectly fine with not having kids of my own as long as I can support the ones who go here.
a.Kindergarten.Sharing_love.0: You must adore children otherwise it's impossible to run a kindergarten.
a.Kindergarten.Sharing_love.1: You're right, I do. I couldn't have any of my own so I decided to share my love with others.
a.Kindergarten.Unanimous_decision.summary: There are many nice people in our city and it's an absolute pleasure to help them!
a.Kindergarten.Unanimous_decision.0: This woman is so nice, Ed. We must help her!
a.Kindergarten.Unanimous_decision.1: I totally agree with you. Let's do our best!
a.Kindergarten.Living_the_dream.summary: I'm definitely teaching the kids to be more like Sugar Heroes when they are back.
a.Kindergarten.Living_the_dream.0: We're happy to inform you that the renovation is almost finished. This place is going to be full of kids very soon!
a.Kindergarten.Living_the_dream.1: I can't thank you enough, Heroes! You help us follow our dreams while living yours.
a.Cinema.A_little_recess.summary: I love helping others but I won't be able to do that if I have no energy left.
a.Cinema.A_little_recess.1: A little tired. I wouldn't say no to recess.
a.Cinema.A_little_recess.2: I know just a place to do it!
a.Cinema.The_Rise_of_Cupcakes.summary: Billie needs to relax and there is no better way to do that than watching an epic saga while eating popcorn!
a.Cinema.The_Rise_of_Cupcakes.1: Wow, Ed! You look so real! What are you doing here?
a.Cinema.The_Rise_of_Cupcakes.2: That's because I am! We came to save you and to watch The Rise of Cupcakes 7.
a.Cinema.Cosplay.summary: I miss the times when we had visitor from all over the city and I hope that Ed is right and we'll have them back in no time!
a.Cinema.Cosplay.0: Hey Alfred, aren't you suppose to wear a uniform?
a.Cinema.Cosplay.1: Yeah... But since the earthquake, we didn't have many visitors so I decided to dress like one.
a.Cinema.Cosplay.2: Don't worry! Your cinema will be packed very soon.
a.Cinema.The_souvenir.summary: I'm going to frame this picture and hang it next to the entrance. The city needs to know its heroes!
a.Cinema.The_souvenir.0: Can I take a picture with you before you go?
a.Cinema.The_souvenir.1: Of course, Alfred. We need to finish first, though.
a.Cinema.The_souvenir.2: Yeah, it's a good idea. You'll need your hands to be free to also leave your signature.
a.Cinema.The_screening.summary: I wonder when there will be a movie about Sugar Heroes? They deserve it more than anyone!
a.Cinema.The_screening.0: We're almost finished! Let's get some soda and finally relax.
a.Cinema.The_screening.1: Sounds great! Thank you for everything. Take as much popcorn as you want!
a.Circus.Bussines_and_pleasure.summary: It's important to loosen up and there is no better way to do that than rebuilding the circus!
a.Circus.Bussines_and_pleasure.0: That was really great, Ed! Although, I think that I enjoyed it too much and don't want to stop.
a.Circus.Bussines_and_pleasure.1: It's okay, Billie. It's possible to have some fun and help others at the same time!
a.Circus.The_greatest_show.summary: I'm so happy that someone came to see my show!
a.Circus.The_greatest_show.0: Welcome, travellers! Do you want to witness the greatest show in the world?
a.Circus.The_greatest_show.1: We do but first we need to rebuild the space for you to perform it.
a.Circus.Magic_help.summary: I have to admit that coming here was not my best idea but we still need to help out the poor guy.
a.Circus.Magic_help.0: Do you need some of my magic help?
a.Circus.Magic_help.1: No offence but you don't look like a magician. We'll stick to our usual tools.
a.Circus.Reading_minds.summary: It's probably my childhood trauma talking but it would be really nice to move to the next building already.
a.Circus.Reading_minds.0: This clown seems a bit strange. Do you mind speeding up so we can finish faster?
a.Circus.Reading_minds.1: I didn't know that reading minds was one of you super-powers.
a.Circus.Farewell.summary: Sometimes the best way to relax is to plunge into work. We've learned our lesson and are ready for new challenges!
a.Circus.Farewell.0: Congratulations! We've done everything in our power bring you back your stage.
a.Circus.Farewell.1: Thank you. Are you ready to see me use it?
a.Circus.Farewell.2: Unfortunately, we don't have time for it but good luck with it!
a.Fair.Work_thirst.summary: We've had rested enough and can't wait to get back into action!
a.Fair.Work_thirst.0: I can't wait to get to work, Ed. How about you?
a.Fair.Work_thirst.1: Yeah, me too. Let's get to it!
a.Fair.Unforgettable_experience.summary: I'm certainly impressed with these fellows and can't wait to see them in action!
a.Fair.Unforgettable_experience.0: Gentlemen, can I interest you in an unforgettable experience?
a.Fair.Unforgettable_experience.1: We already have it in abundance. We would rather help you instead.
a.Fair.Good_hands.summary: We always take care of everything as if it's our own!
a.Fair.Good_hands.0: Don't you worry, sir! Your fair is in good hands.
a.Fair.Best_sweets.summary: Sugar Heroes are the best at what they do so it's not surprising that they know the best suppliers.
a.Fair.Best_sweets.0: We have an idea! How would you like us to hook you up with the suppliers of the best sweets in the city?
a.Fair.Colorful_celebration.summary: It's nice to know that we can come back here any time to borrow some fireworks!
a.Fair.Colorful_celebration.0: How would you like to celebrate the completion of this massive renovation by launching some fireworks?
a.Fair.Colorful_celebration.1: It sounds fun but it might damage the tent. Although now we know where to get fireworks if we ever need them.
a.Roller_coaster.Lucky_neighbor.summary: I'm truly lucky to have such a great neighbor and he is lucky to have Sugar Heroes visiting him.
a.Roller_coaster.Lucky_neighbor.0: Hey neighbor! Do you mind introducing me to your new friends?
a.Roller_coaster.Lucky_neighbor.1: Sure, Walt. Say hi to Sugar Heroes. Maybe they can help you too?
a.Roller_coaster.Interesting_fact.summary: Yes, we have to be tough and fearless but there are things we are not particularly fond of.
a.Roller_coaster.Interesting_fact.0: Do you want to take a ride after it's all done?
a.Roller_coaster.Interesting_fact.1: We know that we supposed to be heroes and everything but we're scared of roller coasters...
a.Roller_coaster.Exceeding_expectations.su: Everyone heard the legends about Sugar Heroes and their feats but not everyone was lucky enough to witness them in person!
a.Roller_coaster.Exceeding_expectations.0: Alright, we've examined everything and it's clear what we need to do.
a.Roller_coaster.Exceeding_expectations.1: You work even faster than in the rumors about you!
a.Roller_coaster.Teamwork.summary: It's great to work in a team. We can always rely on each other which makes everything so much better!
a.Roller_coaster.Teamwork.0: Hey, Ed! I thought we had enough materials to repair this thing but we don't...
a.Roller_coaster.Teamwork.1: Don't worry, Billie! I'll go get some. Just tell me what we need.
a.Roller_coaster.Double-check.summary: I had to try to convince Sugar Heroes again. Even though they didn't indulge me I'm forever grateful for their help.
a.Roller_coaster.Double-check.0: I can't believe that I'm saying that but the roller coaster will be soon available for everyone to enjoy.
a.Roller_coaster.Double-check.1: Thank you! Are you sure that you don't want to ride it? Just once?
a.Roller_coaster.Double-check.2: I've never been so sure about anything in my life!
a.Gallery.The_solution.summary: Ed wants to feel safe again and I know a place full of tranquility. He’s going to love it!
a.Gallery.The_solution.0: I don’t know about you but I want to get away from the heights…
a.Gallery.The_solution.1: I know a type of heights that you won’t scare you. Follow me!
a.Gallery.High_Art.summary: I’m so happy to see Billie! It’s been too long since his last visit.
a.Gallery.High_Art.0: Billie, my friend! Welcome back, mi amigo!
a.Gallery.High_Art.1: Hola, Pablo! I see that your gallery was affected too. Together we can fix it!
a.Gallery.Part-time_job.summary: I have only the fondest memories of Billie and his time here!
a.Gallery.Part-time_job.0: How do you guys know each other?
a.Gallery.Part-time_job.1: I used to work here as a janitor every summer.
a.Gallery.Part-time_job.2: He was amazing. The place always looked tidy!
a.Gallery.Friendship.summary: I know that it’s our job to help everyone but it feels special when you get a chance to save a friend.
a.Gallery.Friendship.0: Why didn’t you reach out to me when right away?
a.Gallery.Friendship.1: You have more important things to do than saving my gallery.
a.Gallery.Friendship.2: Nothing is more important than helping your friends out.
a.Gallery.Artistic_appraisal.summary: I know that Sugar Heroes are busy but I would like to paint them when they go on their well-deserved vacation.
a.Gallery.Artistic_appraisal.0: You’re not finished yet but I already see that it’s going to turn out great!
a.Gallery.Artistic_appraisal.1: Thank you, Pablo. Praise from a true artist is always valuable.
a.Museum.Cultural_enlightment.summary: I'm very hungry! Only this time I crave not food but knowledge.
a.Museum.Cultural_enlightment.0: You know what, the time we spent at the galery made me want to learn more about the culture.
a.Museum.Cultural_enlightment.1: In that case, let's stop by at the local museum. I bet they having some trouble too.
a.Museum.Closed_exhibition.summary: I always welcome new visitors. Especially in these difficult times.
a.Museum.Closed_exhibition.0: Hello? Who is curating the museum?
a.Museum.Closed_exhibition.1: That would be me, young man. If you're here for the exhibition it's temporarily closed.
a.Museum.Closed_exhibition.2: We are here to help you!
a.Museum.Database.summary: Some facts about the city are very surprising. And I know them all!
a.Museum.Database.0: I was wondering how long have you been working here?
a.Museum.Database.1: Oh, dear boy, maybe even too long. I know everything about the city and its history.
a.Museum.Good_thinking.summary: Being curious got us here. It might as well be the thing that'll propell us forward.
a.Museum.Good_thinking.0: Listen, Ed. Maybe we can ask the curator about Mr. Brain.
a.Museum.Good_thinking.1: Good thinking, Billie. Let's give it a try!
a.Museum.Memory_loss.summary: I hope that I didn't let anyone down. I forgot to mention my problem.
a.Museum.Memory_loss.0: You mentioned that you know a lot about the city. Does this apply to the citizens?
a.Museum.Memory_loss.1: I'm sorry, who are you? I have a condition. Short-time memory loss.
a.Museum.Memory_loss.2: Oh, don't worry. We're just helping you with the renovation. We'll be gone soon.
a.Museum.New_way.summary: Things didn't work out the way we expected it them to but it won't stop us in our pursuit for the truth.
a.Museum.New_way.0: I apologise if I promised you something and forgot about it. I just can't help it.
a.Museum.New_way.1: It's okay. We'll find other way to find what we need. You can enjoy your rejuvenated museum.
a.Hotel.Great_run.summary: We don't like to stop when having a good time!
a.Hotel.Great_run.0: We're having a great run, don't we?
a.Hotel.Great_run.1: As always. Let's see who we can help next.
a.Hotel.Spot_on.summary: We know it's a trouble when we see one. Let's help our new friend!
a.Hotel.Spot_on.0: Hey, guys, are you Sugar Heroes?
a.Hotel.Spot_on.1: Indeed we are! It seems like you might need some help?
a.Hotel.Spot_on.2: Spot on! No wonder that you're the best.
a.Hotel.Best_customer.summary: Mr. Brain was always kind to me when he stayed here. I can only say good things about him.
a.Hotel.Best_customer.0: Do you have a lot of celebrities come to your hotel?
a.Hotel.Best_customer.1: Not really. We've had a couple of artists and athletes last month but nobody stayed here after Mr. Brain.
a.Hotel.Best_customer.3: Of course, he is one of our best customers.
a.Hotel.Leaving_behind.summary: I just wish that he left us something too. For example, a note that explains everything.
a.Hotel.Leaving_behind.0: Can you tell us more about the professor's last visit?
a.Hotel.Leaving_behind.1: He left a large suitcase in our cloakroom but he never came back for it.
a.Hotel.Leaving_behind.2: It seems like he left everything behind.
a.Hotel.Mutual_Help.summary: I wish I knew more. Sugar Heroes deserve to know what's happening.
a.Hotel.Mutual_Help.0: You might not realize this but you helped us a lot.
a.Hotel.Mutual_Help.1: Not more than you helped me!
a.Ferris_Wheel.Potent_distraction.summary: I need to clear my head and facing my fears should be a good way to do it.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Potent_distraction.0: I know that you're afraid of heights, Ed, but this Ferris wheel looks like it's in trouble.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Potent_distraction.1: I'm in! It seems like a potent enough distraction from the thought about Mr. Brain.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Self-awareness.summary: It's about time for this wheel to be fixed. Maybe these nice fellows will help me!
a.Ferris_Wheel.Self-awareness.0: Hi there! Do you mind if we take a look at the wheel?
a.Ferris_Wheel.Self-awareness.1: I'm sorry but it doesn't work and I don't know anyone who can fix it.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Rich_experience.summary: It looks like these guys know what they are doing! They have the equipment and stuff...
a.Ferris_Wheel.Rich_experience.0: I didn't expect you to fix it yourself! Are you sure you can do this?
a.Ferris_Wheel.Rich_experience.1: Don't worry, Ferris. We know a thing or two about repairing stuff.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Facing_fears.summary: I can't avoid heights for the rest of my life. It's a perfect moment to deal with them.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Facing_fears.0: Billie, let me fix the top.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Facing_fears.2: The best way to deal with fear is to face it.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Bright_future.summary: I'm glad that I did it. The future has never looked so bright!
a.Ferris_Wheel.Bright_future.0: It wasn't that scary after all.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Bright_future.2: Being on top of the wheel.
a.Ferris_Wheel.Bright_future.3: It's not scary. It's the best!
a.Laundromat.Fresh_start.summary: Local laundry should be a perfect place to clean ourselves up.
a.Laundromat.Fresh_start.0: Hey, Billie, do you know a place where we can freshen up?
a.Laundromat.Fresh_start.1: Good idea, Ed! We've been cleaning everything around and forgot about staying clean ourselves. Follow me!
a.Laundromat.Clean_up.summary: I hope someone will finally help me get the water supply back because I miss the smell of laundry!
a.Laundromat.Clean_up.0: Hello! Can we use your wonderful laundry place to clean ourselves up?
a.Laundromat.Clean_up.1: Sure. But you'll have to help me first because there is no water supply.
a.Laundromat.Expert_help.summary: Thankfully our city is full of citizens ready to help each other out!
a.Laundromat.Expert_help.0: We still know very little about water and its supply so maybe we should reach out to an expert?
a.Laundromat.Synergy_effect.summary: We should do it more often. Working together with others is fun!
a.Laundromat.Synergy_effect.0: I'm so glad you asked me. With your equipment and my expertise, we will deal with it in no time!
a.Laundromat.Synergy_effect.1: We are glad that we asked you too!
a.Laundromat.Word_of_mouth.summary: I hope that Sugar Heroes will like their new acquaintance!
a.Laundromat.Word_of_mouth.0: You're really nice fellows! I'll refer you to my friend.
a.Laundromat.Word_of_mouth.1: Thank you! How can we find him?
a.Laundromat.Word_of_mouth.2: Don't worry. He will find you himself.
a.Barbershop.Trading_places.summary: My friend told me that these guys need some help but maybe they can help me instead!
a.Barbershop.Trading_places.0: Hey guys! I was told that you need some help with your looks?
a.Barbershop.Trading_places.1: Ummmm... We're not sure what you mean.
a.Barbershop.Trading_places.2: Well, if you don't care about your looks you can help me with my barbershop.
a.Barbershop.Creating_art.summary: This is a temple of beauty and I hope that it will be opening its doors to the public soon.
a.Barbershop.Creating_art.0: So, what exactly do you do here? Cut hair?
a.Barbershop.Creating_art.1: That's an oversimplification. I make art. I'll show you when we're done!
a.Barbershop.Rediscovering.summary: My work is my life so I can't wait to start living again!
a.Barbershop.Rediscovering.0: Why did you choose this profession?
a.Barbershop.Rediscovering.1: I just feel so good when I help people find their new selves.
a.Barbershop.Inspiring_example.summary: I'm really happy that I was able to reach out to Sugar Heroes and affect their lives if even in a small way.
a.Barbershop.Inspiring_example.0: Your example is so inspiring! We'll make sure to bring this barbershop back to life.
a.Barbershop.Temple_of_beauty.summary: I am thinking about creating a new hairstyle and naming it after Sugar Heroes. It's the least I can do!
a.Barbershop.Temple_of_beauty.0: We had a lot of fun working with you. If we ever need a haircut we know where to go.
a.Barbershop.Temple_of_beauty.1: You're always welcome at the temple of beauty!
a.House_of_cards.Valuable_information.summ: I believe that I have something important to say to Sugar Heroes.
a.House_of_cards.Valuable_information.0: Greetings, travelers! Why don't you help me with my house in exchange for some information?
a.House_of_cards.Valuable_information.1: What a curious offer. We'll see what we can do.
a.House_of_cards.Fortune_telling.summary: I know things that nobody else does but I only tell them to the ones who listen.
a.House_of_cards.Fortune_telling.0: What is exactly that you do?
a.House_of_cards.Fortune_telling.1: I tell fortune. Give me a moment to get my cards.
a.House_of_cards.Strange_things.summary: Something doesn't feel right about it but we can't just leave.
a.House_of_cards.Strange_things.0: What do you think about all this, Billie?
a.House_of_cards.Strange_things.1: I don't know, Ed. It seems a bit strange.
a.House_of_cards.Strange_things.2: Let's just finish the job and see what happens.
a.House_of_cards.Magic_cards.summary: Sugar Heroes aren't the only ones blessed with superpowers. My cards make things happen too.
a.House_of_cards.Magic_cards.0: I have my cards now so I can tell you where should you go to find your professor.
a.House_of_cards.The_wizard.summary: My job here is done. I thank Sugar Heroes and wish them all the best on their quest.
a.House_of_cards.The_wizard.0: To find the professor you need to first find the wizard who goes by the name Merlin.
a.House_of_cards.The_wizard.2: Don't you worry. You'll have my magic ball after the house is restored.
a.Clock_Tower.Tricky_navigation.summary: Let's see where the magic ball takes us!
a.Clock_Tower.Tricky_navigation.0: Well, the magic ball says that we need to go to the Clock Tower. That's where Merlin is.
a.Clock_Tower.Tricky_navigation.1: Then Clock Tower it is. Let's grab everything we might need and hit the road.
a.Clock_Tower.Sweet_treats.summary: Putting the most delicious treats together is one of our specialties!
a.Clock_Tower.Sweet_treats.0: Excuse me, we are looking for Merlin. Do you happen to know where can we find him?
a.Clock_Tower.Sweet_treats.1: I might know him but I have some trouble remembering things.
a.Clock_Tower.Sweet_treats.2: Will some sweet treats help you with recollection?
a.Clock_Tower.Personal_items.summary: I must say I missed my wizardry and I am glad that Sugar Heroes have found me.
a.Clock_Tower.Personal_items.0: I just remembered that I am Merlin. Thank you for bringing up this memory. How can I help you?
a.Clock_Tower.Personal_items.1: We were looking for you so you would help us find someone else.
a.Clock_Tower.Personal_items.2: I can do that. I'll just need some of the personal items that belong to the wanted person.
a.Clock_Tower.The_ritual.summary: Now that we have all we need it's time to find the professor!
a.Clock_Tower.The_ritual.0: Alright, it looks like we can start the ritual now. Who is this Mr. Brain anyway?
a.Clock_Tower.The_ritual.1: He is our mentor and one of the greatest citizens this city ever had.
a.Clock_Tower.The_ritual.2: He sounds wonderful! We have no other choice than to find him.
a.Clock_Tower.Ancient_scroll.summary: I hope that my help will lead Sugar Heroes to all the right places.
a.Clock_Tower.Ancient_scroll.0: I know I was supposed to only help you find your professor but you've helped me so much that I decided to do something extra...
a.Clock_Tower.Ancient_scroll.2: Please accept this ancient scroll. It will answer more of your questions when you have them.
a.Candy_Store.Delicious_craving.summary: I hope that we will find something out about Mr. Brain and eat something tasty there!
a.Candy_Store.Delicious_craving.0: The scroll says that we need to visit the local Candy Store.
a.Candy_Store.Delicious_craving.1: That's actually great! I am craving something delicious!
a.Candy_Store.All_ears.summary: I hope Sugar Heroes don't mind my outfit. It makes me feel special.
a.Candy_Store.All_ears.0: Hello! How can I help you?
a.Candy_Store.All_ears.1: Oh, you scared us! We just wanted to ask you some questions.
a.Candy_Store.All_ears.2: Don't worry. It's just a costume. I'm all ears.
a.Candy_Store.Unstable_components.summary: This story sounds exactly like Mr. Brain!
a.Candy_Store.Unstable_components.0: First of all, what happened to your store?
a.Candy_Store.Unstable_components.1: Some professor was experimenting with unstable components down in the basement and it went horribly wrong.
a.Candy_Store.Unstable_components.2: We would love to help you fix it while you tell us more about the professor.
a.Candy_Store.Scientific_basement.summary: If we work fast we can fix the store and still catch up with Mr. Brain.
a.Candy_Store.Scientific_basement.0: Thank you for helping but there isn't much I can say. He was paying me the rent to use the basement as his laboratory.
a.Candy_Store.Scientific_basement.1: For how long did he stay?
a.Candy_Store.Scientific_basement.2: I don't remember anymore but he left right after the accident last week.
a.Candy_Store.Ear_to_the_ground.summary: I hope that Sugar Heroes find the professor even though he did cost me my store.
a.Candy_Store.Ear_to_the_ground.0: How can I thank you for helping me out?
a.Candy_Store.Ear_to_the_ground.1: Just let us know if you hear anything from the professor.
a.Candy_Store.Ear_to_the_ground.2: Will do! Feel free to come by the store for the sweets at any time!
a.Greengrocer.Finding_out.summary: The only way to get the answers is to look for them!
a.Greengrocer.Finding_out.1: I don't know why but the scroll says we need to go to the local Greengrocer.
a.Greengrocer.Busy_day.summary: I don't remember the last time I was so happy to see someone!
a.Greengrocer.Busy_day.0: Oh my god, what's up with the costumes here? We have a reason to believe that a professor was here recently.
a.Greengrocer.Busy_day.1: I would love to help you but I'm too busy cleaning up.
a.Greengrocer.Busy_day.2: Don't worry about cleaning. Just tell us everything you know while we tidy up.
a.Greengrocer.Big_Bang.summary: We always knew that Mr. Brain was thinking big but didn't realize exactly how big.
a.Greengrocer.Big_Bang.0: And what happened to your shop?
a.Greengrocer.Big_Bang.1: You didn't hear? There was an explosion at the Candy store.
a.Greengrocer.Big_Bang.2: We knew about it but didn't think it was that big...
a.Greengrocer.Clueless.summary: We are very curious about what Mr. Brain was trying to make and we will find this out eventually.
a.Greengrocer.Clueless.0: How did you meet the professor if he wasn't living in your basement?
a.Greengrocer.Clueless.1: He came here to buy get the ingredients a lot.
a.Greengrocer.Clueless.2: Do you know what he was working on?
a.Greengrocer.Hero's_duty.summary: If I see or hear anything about the professor I'll let Sugar Heroes know!
a.Greengrocer.Hero's_duty.0: Thank you for your help. I wish I was more useful to you.
a.Greengrocer.Hero's_duty.1: Don't mention it! It was our pleasure.
a.Haunted_House.Strange_noise.summary: The house looks scary so we should probably arm ourselves.
a.Haunted_House.Strange_noise.1: I think it was coming from this house. Let’s check!
a.Haunted_House.Scary_ghost.summary: I guess we’ll have to use something more powerful to fight this creature!
a.Haunted_House.Getting_warm.summary: I’m sorry if I scared anyone but my sheets are the warmest thing I’ve left.
a.Haunted_House.Getting_warm.2: Why do you look like this?
a.Haunted_House.Getting_warm.3: I just got cold. Heating doesn’t work since the accident.
a.Haunted_House.Whitemail.summary: I might never get a chance to clean up my house again so I have no other choice but to ask Sugar Heroes for help.
a.Haunted_House.Whitemail.0: Your house was also affected by the explosion?
a.Haunted_House.Whitemail.1: To be fair it was in pretty bad shape even before that.
a.Haunted_House.Whitemail.2: Did you happen to see the professor?
a.Haunted_House.Whitemail.3: I know exactly where he went and I’m willing to share this information with you in exchange for a favor.
a.Haunted_House.Final_destination.summary: We finally know where Mr. Brain is! Let’s wrap things up here and come to his rescue.
a.Haunted_House.Final_destination.0: Wow, you’re almost done. You work fast!
a.Haunted_House.Final_destination.1: We’re very keen on finding our professor.
a.Haunted_House.Final_destination.2: I see. To do that you must go to the house with the blue roof. He sneaked in there the other night.
a.Haunted_House.Final_destination.3: You have no idea how much does this means to us!
a.Witch's_House.Blue_roof.summary: There is the only way to find out if it’s the right house!
a.Witch's_House.Blue_roof.0: Do you think this is the right house?
a.Witch's_House.Blue_roof.1: I don’t see any other buildings with blue roofs around here.
a.Witch's_House.The_warning.summary: I don’t know who this lovely lady is but she knows Mr. Brain and it’s everything that matters.
a.Witch's_House.The_warning.0: Welcome, Sugar Heroes! I’ve been warned that you’ll show up.
a.Witch's_House.The_warning.2: Mr. Brain told me that himself.
a.Witch's_House.The_test.summary: Mr. Brain is very cautious so I need to make sure that everything is safe.
a.Witch's_House.The_test.0: Mr. Brain gave me specific instructions which I’m supposed to share with you if you pass a test.
a.Witch's_House.The_test.2: The one that will prove that you really are Sugar Heroes.
a.Witch's_House.Truth_serum.summary: It’s been a while since we participated in creating some kind of formula. I already forgot how exciting it is!
a.Witch's_House.Truth_serum.0: First, I need to concoct a truth serum. Do you mind getting me the ingredients?
a.Witch's_House.Truth_serum.1: Not at all! Just give us a list and we’ll be on our way.
a.Witch's_House.Free_time.summary: Mr. Brain spoke a great deal of Sugar Heroes and they lived up to his every word.
a.Witch's_House.Free_time.1: Thank you. So, what’s the test?
a.Witch's_House.Free_time.2: You’ve already passed it. You dedicated yourself to a good deed without asking any question. Only Sugar Heroes would do that.
a.Witch's_House.Free_time.3: It looks like we have some time to spare now so why don't we fix your house up!
a.Safe_House.Good_feeling.summary: It's finally happening and we couldn't be more excited about it!
a.Safe_House.Good_feeling.0: Are you ready to see Mr. Brain?
a.Safe_House.Good_feeling.1: Yes, I have a good feeling about it.
a.Safe_House.Cautious_measures.summary: I've something to tell Sugar Heroes but we need to make sure nobody else hears us.
a.Safe_House.Cautious_measures.1: Great, you're finally here. Come in!
a.Safe_House.Too_suspicious.summary: The first order of business is to make this place look less suspicious.
a.Safe_House.Too_suspicious.0: So, what's going on Mr. Green? What is this place?
a.Safe_House.Too_suspicious.1: It's a safe house and I neeв your help making it look normal.
a.Safe_House.Great_danger.summary: There are safety rules we have to follow to keep the operation going.
a.Safe_House.Great_danger.0: Are you planning on telling us what this all is about?
a.Safe_House.Great_danger.1: Mr. Brain and I worked together but we had to split up because it became dangerous for us to travel together.
a.Safe_House.Great_danger.2: What are you talking about? Can we help?
a.Safe_House.Great_danger.3: Yes. By going to the address I'll give you after you finish here.
a.Safe_House.So_long.summary: I don't want to say goodbye but we don't have any other choice at the moment.
a.Safe_House.So_long.0: How much more time do you need? You can's stay here for too long.
a.Safe_House.So_long.2: Great. Good luck, Sugar Heroes. I hope to see you soon.
a.Donut_Factory.Unclear_reason.summary: Things are getting weirder with our every move but it makes me even more curious!
a.Donut_Factory.Unclear_reason.0: Are you sure this is the right address?
a.Donut_Factory.Unclear_reason.1: That's where Mr. Green wanted us to go.
a.Donut_Factory.Unclear_reason.2: Okay, let's go in and find out why.
a.Donut_Factory.Third_Hero.summary: I'm excited to see my friends too but we have to be discreet.
a.Donut_Factory.Third_Hero.2: Lower your voices and follow me.
a.Donut_Factory.Secret_mission.summary: I want to just sit down and talk about hero stuff but we have a very time-sensitive matter at our hands.
a.Donut_Factory.Secret_mission.0: How are you? We haven't seen you since you went on your secret mission.
a.Donut_Factory.Secret_mission.1: Yeah, how was it? I'm sure you have a lot of stories to tell.
a.Donut_Factory.Secret_mission.2: I do but now is not the time to tell them. It's time to save the city.
a.Donut_Factory.The_headquarters.summary: It's a great feeling to be a part of an ever big team now!
a.Donut_Factory.The_headquarters.0: Here is what I need you to do. Renovate this factory and make it into our headquarters.
a.Donut_Factory.The_headquarters.1: Sounds like a piece of cake!
a.Donut_Factory.Course_of_action.summary: We finally get to do something exciting and familiar!
a.Donut_Factory.Course_of_action.0: We're almost done, Donutello! What else do you need us to do.
a.Donut_Factory.Course_of_action.1: Do what you do best, help everyone around you. I'll reach out when I have some news.
a.Gas_station.First_priority.summary: As much as we want to know what's happening, we are still here to help the citizens.
a.Gas_station.First_priority.0: It's kind of hard to pretend that's nothing is happening after what we just went through.
a.Gas_station.First_priority.1: We have no choice, the city needs us!
a.Gas_station.Awful_look.summary: Maybe after Sugar Heroes help me, the station will have more customers!
a.Gas_station.Awful_look.0: This place looks like it needs some cleanup. Am I right?
a.Gas_station.Awful_look.1: Yeah... It's embarrassing how awful it does look.
a.Gas_station.Awful_look.2: Don't worry. We're here to help!
a.Gas_station.Strange_times.summary: It's good to know that Sugar Heroes got our backs!
a.Gas_station.Strange_times.1: Not that great, to be honest. These are strange times for our city.
a.Gas_station.Strange_times.2: Indeed they are, but we're doing our best to change that.
a.Gas_station.Back_in_business.summary: I'm so excited! I know that my gasoline is the best in the city and now I have a chance to prove it.
a.Gas_station.Back_in_business.0: Do you need my help at all?
a.Gas_station.Back_in_business.1: We're fine. You should better call your customers to tell them that you're back in the game!
a.Gas_station.Happy_moment.summary: We live for moments like this. Once the gas station is open again, we will be able to help someone else.
a.Gas_station.Happy_moment.0: Almost done! Are you ready for the grand reopening?
a.Gas_station.Happy_moment.1: Are you kidding me? This is the happiest I've been!
a.Car_shop.Accurate_rumors.summary: It sounds challenging, but we wouldn't have it any other way!
a.Car_shop.Accurate_rumors.0: Excuse me, I just heard that you brought the gas station back to life.
a.Car_shop.Accurate_rumors.2: Do you think you pull off the same trick with my car shop?
a.Car_shop.Fearless_heroes.summary: I've heard about Sugar Heroes, but I've never seen them in action!
a.Car_shop.Fearless_heroes.0: Frankly speaking, I didn't think you'll say yes. This place is in pretty bad shape.
a.Car_shop.Under_control.summary: I have nothing but respect for Sugar Heroes and the way they deal with problems.
a.Car_shop.Under_control.0: You weren't lying when you said that this place has problems.
a.Car_shop.Under_control.1: But nothing that we can't handle. We just need to grab some extra equipment.
a.Car_shop.Under_control.2: Alright. I'll be right here waiting for you.
a.Car_shop.Another_errand.summary: I have all the time in the world. I just hope I'm not wasting someone else's time.
a.Car_shop.Another_errand.0: We're back, but not for long.
a.Car_shop.Another_errand.1: We need to run another errand. Stay put.
a.Car_shop.Another_errand.2: Don't worry. I've nothing else to go.
a.Car_shop.Unforgettable_feeling.summary: This day feels like my second birthday, but Sugar Heroes are the ones who should be celebrated!
a.Car_shop.Unforgettable_feeling.0: It seems like we'll be finished soon.
a.Car_shop.Unforgettable_feeling.1: Few extra touches and your shop will be as good as new.
a.Car_shop.Unforgettable_feeling.2: This is incredible, Heroes! Thank you. I'll never forget this.
a.Car_Wash.Words_versus_actions.summary: It's time to show what Sugar Heroes are made of.
a.Car_Wash.Words_versus_actions.0: Looks like this car wash needs a wash itself.
a.Car_Wash.Words_versus_actions.1: Are we going to just talk about it or actually do something?
a.Car_Wash.Ambitious_statement.summary: I feel pretty good about this one. We will make it work!
a.Car_Wash.Ambitious_statement.0: Hi, Heroes! Are you here to help me?
a.Car_Wash.Ambitious_statement.2: Prepare your sunglasses because when we're done, this place is going to shine!
a.Car_Wash.Massive_drought.summary: I feel embarrassed about the fact that there is no water at my car wash.
a.Car_Wash.Massive_drought.0: Do you have some water here?
a.Car_Wash.Massive_drought.1: I don't think I do, sorry.
a.Car_Wash.Massive_drought.2: No worries. We know where to get it!
a.Car_Wash.Good_friends.summary: It's fantastic to see Sugar Heroes in action. They're simply the best!
a.Car_Wash.Good_friends.0: Where did you find all this water?
a.Car_Wash.Good_friends.1: We have friends at the Water Treatment Plant.
a.Car_Wash.Fast-paced.summary: I thought I was fast at washing cars before I met Sugar Heroes!
a.Car_Wash.Fast-paced.0: When you said that you're going to help I didn't expect it to happen so fast.
a.Wellness_center.Work_before_leisure.summ: We already deserve to rest, but some extra effort will make it even more valuable.
a.Wellness_center.Work_before_leisure.0: I'm getting a little tired, Billie. How about you?
a.Wellness_center.Work_before_leisure.1: Yeah, we need to relax but let's do something first.
a.Wellness_center.Day_off.summary: I love Billie, but sometimes I wish he was a little less intense.
a.Wellness_center.Day_off.0: Welcome, Sugar Heroes! I'm so happy that you decided to help me.
a.Wellness_center.Day_off.1: This is your idea of a day off?
a.Wellness_center.Day_off.2: Come on, Ed! We got to earn it.
a.Wellness_center.Spa_treatment.summary: Sugar Heroes do a lot for our community, and it's important to give something back to them whenever we have a chance.
a.Wellness_center.Spa_treatment.2: Okay. I'll go and make sure that you get the best spa treatment after you're done.
a.Wellness_center.Something_in_return.summ: I must admit that it was a great plan, and it worked perfectly!
a.Wellness_center.Something_in_return.0: I underestimated you, Billie. It was your plan all along, wasn't it?
a.Wellness_center.Something_in_return.1: There is nothing wrong with getting something in return for being helpful.
a.Wellness_center.Just_in_time.summary: I hope that Sugar Heroes enjoy my signature bath with apple and cinnamon flavor. They deserve it!
a.Wellness_center.Just_in_time.0: Good news! We're finishing up with the exterior. It will be done soon.
a.Wellness_center.Just_in_time.1: Excellent! The hot chocolate bath will be ready just in time!
a.Rink.Exciting_endeavor.summary: I don't know what Ed has in mind but I'm up for anything!
a.Rink.Exciting_endeavor.0: Hey, Billie, do you know what I think will be fun for us to do?
a.Rink.Exciting_endeavor.1: No, but I'm curious to know!
a.Rink.Lucky_visit.summary: I want to skate so much that I'm willing to do whatever it takes to fix this rink!
a.Rink.Lucky_visit.0: Excuse me, is your rink open for visitors?
a.Rink.Lucky_visit.1: Yes, but we don't have any of them anymore.
a.Rink.Lucky_visit.2: Well, you're in luck! We're here to help you.
a.Rink.Ice_delivery.summary: Is there anything I love more than ice? No! So I'm extremely happy about being involved.
a.Rink.Ice_delivery.0: Do you need any help? I'm pretty strong.
a.Rink.Ice_delivery.1: Yeah, sure. Do you mind helping us carry the ice? We're going to need a lot of it.
